source.text: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ עַם־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֶת־יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיַּמְלִיכֻ֥הוּ תַֽחַת־אָבִ֖יו בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And took [the] people of the land Jehoahaz son of Josiah, and made him king in place of his father in Jerusalem.

en.L: And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in place of his father in Jerusalem.
en.B: The people of the land then took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem to succeed his father.
en.R: After that, the people of the land chose Josiah's son Jehoahaz. They made him king in Jerusalem in his father's place.

es.L: Y el pueblo de la tierra tomó a Joacaz hijo de Josías, y lo hizo rey en lugar de su padre en Jerusalén.
es.B: Entonces el pueblo de la tierra tomó a Joacaz hijo de Josías y lo hizo rey en Jerusalén en lugar de su padre.
es.R: Después, el pueblo de la tierra escogió a Joacaz, el hijo de Josías. Lo hicieron rey en Jerusalén en lugar de su padre.

fr.L: Et le peuple du pays prit Joachaz fils de Josias et le fit roi à la place de son père à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Le peuple du pays prit alors Joachaz, fils de Josias, et le fit roi à Jérusalem à la place de son père.
fr.R: Ensuite, le peuple du pays a choisi Joachaz, le fils de Josias. Ils l’ont fait roi à Jérusalem à la place de son père.

sw.L: Nao watu wa nchi wakamchukua Yehoahazi mwana wa Yosia, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kisha watu wa nchi wakamchukua Yehoahazi mwana wa Yosia, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme huko Yerusalemu mahali pa baba yake.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, watu wa nchi walimchagua Yehoahazi, mwana wa Yosia. Wakamfanya kuwa mfalme huko Yerusalemu mahali pa baba yake.

vi.L: Dân trong xứ lấy Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a và lập ông làm vua thay cha mình tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân trong xứ chọn Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a và lập ông làm vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, kế vị cha mình.
vi.R: Sau đó, dân trong xứ chọn Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a. Họ lập ông làm vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem thay cha mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그 땅의 백성이 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 데려다가 예루살렘에서 그의 아버지를 대신하여 그를 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 그 땅의 백성은 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 데려다가 예루살렘에서 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 그 땅의 백성은 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 골랐다. 그들은 예루살렘에서 그를 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E o povo da terra tomou Jeoacaz, filho de Josias, e o fez rei em lugar do seu pai em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Então o povo da terra tomou Jeoacaz, filho de Josias, e o fez rei em Jerusalém, no lugar do seu pai.
pt.R: Depois disso, o povo da terra escolheu Jeoacaz, filho de Josias. Eles o fizeram rei em Jerusalém, no lugar do seu pai.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 23:30b, without the anointing
decisions.reason: Verses 1-10 follow 2 Kings 23:30-24:17 in shortened form. Kings says the people of the land took Jehoahaz "and anointed him and made him king"; Chronicles leaves out the anointing and adds "in Jerusalem". The account of Josiah's death and burial comes just before (35:20-27).

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: As in 23:20-21 and 33:25, the free people of Judah act together to put a king on the throne. They chose Jehoahaz although his brother Eliakim was older (verses 2, 5).

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz: also called Shallum
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 22:11 and 1 Chronicles 3:15 call this son of Josiah Shallum. Jehoahaz may have been the name he took as king.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 23:30b
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording from 2 Kings 23:30b where the Hebrew is the same, and adds "in Jerusalem" where Chronicles has it.

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 23:30b-24:19
decisions.reason: The last kings of Judah keep the Spanish of 2 Kings 23:30-24:19 at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, with "en Jerusalén" where Chronicles adds it; Joacaz as the terms note writes Jehoahaz.

decisions.choice: the wording of French 2 Kings 23:30b, without the anointing, with "à Jérusalem"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the same Hebrew without "anointed him", and adds "in Jerusalem".

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 23:30-25:21
decisions.reason: This chapter retells the last kings from 2 Kings 23-25; where the Hebrew is the same, each level keeps the Swahili of Kings and differs only where Chronicles differs.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 23:30b without the anointing; "Giô-a-cha"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of Kings without "anointed him" (m1); the king keeps the name this verse gives him, as the terms note says.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 23:30b with "예루살렘에서" added and no anointing
decisions.reason: Chronicles leaves out the anointing and adds the place; the rest keeps the Kings wording at each level.

decisions.choice: o povo da terra tomou Jeoacaz (L, B), escolheu (R); em Jerusalém
decisions.reason: Verses 1-10 follow 2 Kings 23:30-24:17 in shorter form (m1), so they keep that passage's Portuguese level by level where the Hebrew is the same: here "o povo da terra" and "Jeoacaz", as 2 Kings 23:30 has them, without the anointing, which Chronicles leaves out, and with "em Jerusalém" added.

source.text: בֶּן־שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה יוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of three and twenty year[s] [was] Jehoahaz when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: A son of twenty-three years [was] Jehoahaz when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem.
en.B: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
en.R: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for three months.

es.L: Hijo de veintitrés años [era] Joacaz cuando comenzó a reinar, y tres meses reinó en Jerusalén.
es.B: Joacaz tenía veintitrés años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó tres meses en Jerusalén.
es.R: Joacaz tenía veintitrés años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante tres meses.

fr.L: Joachaz [avait] vingt-trois ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Joachaz avait vingt-trois ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Joachaz avait vingt-trois ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trois mois.

sw.L: Yehoahazi [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala, na miezi mitatu alitawala huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Yehoahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miezi mitatu huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yehoahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miezi mitatu.

vi.L: Giô-a-cha [được] hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Giô-a-cha được hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Giô-a-cha được hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba tháng.

ko.L: 여호아하스가 왕이 되었을 때 23세[였고], 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 여호아하스는 23세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 여호아하스는 23세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: Jeoacaz [tinha] vinte e três anos quando começou a reinar, e três meses reinou em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Jeoacaz tinha vinte e três anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou três meses em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Jeoacaz tinha vinte e três anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante três meses.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 23:31 without the name of his mother
decisions.reason: The age and the length of the reign are the same as in 2 Kings 23:31. Chronicles leaves out his mother, Hamutal, and the verdict on his reign (2 Kings 23:32), as it does for each of the last kings.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-three years: twenty-three years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: Joahaz: a shorter spelling of Jehoahaz
decisions.reason: Here and in verse 4 the name is spelled in its short form, without the first syllable of the divine name. It is the same king as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: the accession formula worded as in 2 Kings 23:31
decisions.reason: Each level reuses the wording of 2 Kings 23:31, so the reader sees that the two books say the same. The short spelling of the name is given in its usual form.

decisions.choice: "Joachaz" for the shorter spelling of the name
decisions.reason: The verse spells the king's name short (m3); French keeps the king's usual form, as the English does, and keeps "Yoachaz" for the official of 34:8.

decisions.choice: "23세" in figures, with "석 달" in words, in the wording of 2 Kings 23:31
decisions.reason: Ages and years are in figures in this block; a short count of months stays in words, as the Kings drafts write it.

decisions.choice: the accession formula of 2 Kings 23:31, without the queen mother; Jeoacaz
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 2 Kings 23:31 at each level, ending at "Jerusalém", since Chronicles leaves out Hamutal and the verdict (m1). The short spelling of the name (m3) is written "Jeoacaz", as the English gives it in its usual form, so the reader sees the king of verse 1.

source.text: וַיְסִירֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲנֹשׁ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And removed him [the] king of Egypt in Jerusalem, and fined the land a hundred talent[s] of silver and a talent of gold.

en.L: And the king of Egypt removed him in Jerusalem, and he imposed a fine on the land, 100 talents of silver and a talent of gold.
en.B: The king of Egypt removed him from the throne in Jerusalem and imposed on the land a payment of {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}} of silver and {{units:about 75 pounds|a talent}} of gold.
en.R: The king of Egypt took the throne away from him in Jerusalem. He forced the land of Judah to pay {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}} of silver and {{units:about 75 pounds|a talent}} of gold.

es.L: Y el rey de Egipto lo destituyó en Jerusalén, e impuso a la tierra una multa de cien talentos de plata y un talento de oro.
es.B: El rey de Egipto lo quitó del trono en Jerusalén e impuso a la tierra un pago de {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}} de plata y {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}} de oro.
es.R: El rey de Egipto le quitó el trono en Jerusalén. Obligó al país de Judá a pagar {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}} de plata y {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}} de oro.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Égypte le destitua à Jérusalem, et il imposa au pays une amende de cent talents d’argent et d’un talent d’or.
fr.B: Le roi d’Égypte le détrôna à Jérusalem et imposa au pays un tribut de {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} d’argent et de {{units:environ 34 kilos|un talent}} d’or.
fr.R: Le roi d’Égypte lui a enlevé son trône à Jérusalem. Il a obligé le pays de Juda à payer {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} d’argent et {{units:environ 34 kilos|un talent}} d’or.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Misri akamwondoa huko Yerusalemu, akaitoza nchi faini, talanta 100 za fedha na talanta moja ya dhahabu.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Misri alimwondoa katika ufalme huko Yerusalemu, akaitoza nchi malipo ya {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}} za fedha na {{units:karibu kilo 34|talanta moja}} ya dhahabu.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Misri alimwondolea ufalme huko Yerusalemu. Akailazimisha nchi ya Yuda kulipa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}} za fedha na {{units:karibu kilo 34|talanta moja}} ya dhahabu.

vi.L: Vua Ai Cập phế ông tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, và bắt xứ phải nộp phạt một trăm ta-lâng bạc và một ta-lâng vàng.
vi.B: Vua Ai Cập truất ngôi ông tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và bắt xứ phải nộp {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg|một trăm ta-lâng}} bạc và {{units:khoảng 34 kg|một ta-lâng}} vàng.
vi.R: Vua Ai Cập phế bỏ ngôi vua của ông tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy bắt xứ Giu-đa phải nộp {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg|một trăm ta-lâng}} bạc và {{units:khoảng 34 kg|một ta-lâng}} vàng.

ko.L: 그리고 이집트 왕이 예루살렘에서 그를 폐위시키고, 그 땅에 은 100달란트와 금 1달란트의 벌금을 물렸다.
ko.B: 이집트 왕은 예루살렘에서 그를 왕위에서 몰아내고, 그 땅에 은 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에다 금 {{units:약 34킬로그램|1달란트}}의 벌금을 물렸다.
ko.R: 이집트 왕은 예루살렘에서 그의 왕위를 빼앗았다. 그리고 유다 땅에 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}의 은과 {{units:약 34킬로그램|1달란트}}의 금을 바치게 했다.

pt.L: E o rei do Egito o depôs em Jerusalém e impôs à terra uma multa de cem talentos de prata e um talento de ouro.
pt.B: O rei do Egito o tirou do trono em Jerusalém e impôs à terra o pagamento de {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}} de prata e {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}} de ouro.
pt.R: O rei do Egito tirou dele o trono em Jerusalém. Ele obrigou a terra de Judá a pagar {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}} de prata e {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}} de ouro.

decisions.choice: removed him in Jerusalem: 2 Kings 23:33 says Neco bound him at Riblah
decisions.reason: Kings says Pharaoh Neco put Jehoahaz in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath "from reigning in Jerusalem". Chronicles gives the result in one word: the king of Egypt removed him, that is, put an end to his reign in Jerusalem. It does not say where it was done.

decisions.choice: fined: laid a payment on a conquered land
decisions.reason: The verb means to impose a penalty or fine. Judah, now under Egypt, had to pay tribute (2 Kings 23:33, 35).

decisions.choice: a talent: about 75 pounds of metal
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 23:33, a talent was the largest weight, about 75 pounds.

decisions.choice: about 7,500 pounds ... about 75 pounds
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 23:33: Balanced and Readable give modern weights, with the talents as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents. Balanced adds "from the throne" to say what "removed" means here.

decisions.choice: "unos 3 400 kilos" / "cien talentos"; "unos 34 kilos" / "un talento"
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 23:33: the units setting gives the weight in kilos, with the talents as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: "environ 3,4 tonnes" / "cent talents"; "environ 34 kilos" / "un talent"
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 23:33: metric by default, the talent at 34 kg.

decisions.choice: units spans "khoảng 3.400 kg" and "khoảng 34 kg", with "ta-lâng" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The terms note's talent of 34 kg, metric by default; Literal keeps "ta-lâng".

decisions.choice: The units spans of 2 Kings 23:33 with figures ("약 3.4톤" / "100달란트", "약 34킬로그램" / "1달란트"), each followed by a particle that fits both wordings ("에다", "의")
alternatives: "백 달란트", "한 달란트", as the 2 Kings 23 draft has
decisions.reason: A talent is about 34 kg (terms note); Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}}; {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}}; o depôs (L), o tirou do trono (B)
decisions.reason: The payment keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 23:33 at each level, kilograms by default at the talent of 34 kg, where the English gives pounds, and talents at Literal (m3). Chronicles gives only the result, that he was removed (m1): "depôs" at Literal, "tirou do trono" at Balanced, as the English.

source.text: וַיַּמְלֵ֨ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֜יִם אֶת־אֶלְיָקִ֣ים אָחִ֗יו עַל־יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־יוֹאָחָ֤ז אָחִיו֙ לָקַ֣ח נְכ֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And made king [the] king of Egypt Eliakim his brother over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name [to] Jehoiakim; and Jehoahaz his brother took Neco, and brought him [to] Egypt.

en.L: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name [to] Jehoiakim; and Jehoahaz his brother Neco took, and he brought him [to] Egypt.
en.B: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, the brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz, Eliakim's brother, and brought him to Egypt.
en.R: The king of Egypt made Jehoahaz's brother Eliakim king over Judah and Jerusalem. He changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Jehoahaz, the new king's brother, away to Egypt.

es.L: Y el rey de Egipto puso por rey a Eliaquim su hermano sobre Judá y Jerusalén, y le cambió el nombre [por] Joacim; y a Joacaz su hermano lo tomó Necao, y lo llevó [a] Egipto.
es.B: El rey de Egipto hizo rey sobre Judá y Jerusalén a Eliaquim, hermano de Joacaz, y le cambió el nombre a Eliaquim por el de Joacim. En cambio, Necao tomó a Joacaz, el hermano de Eliaquim, y se lo llevó a Egipto.
es.R: El rey de Egipto hizo rey sobre Judá y Jerusalén a Eliaquim, el hermano de Joacaz. Le cambió el nombre a Eliaquim y le puso Joacim. Necao se llevó a Egipto a Joacaz, el hermano del nuevo rey.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Égypte fit roi Éliaqim, son frère, sur Juda et Jérusalem, et il changea son nom [en] Joïaqim ; et Joachaz son frère, Néko le prit et l’emmena [en] Égypte.
fr.B: Le roi d’Égypte établit roi sur Juda et Jérusalem Éliaqim, le frère de Joachaz, et il changea le nom d’Éliaqim en Joïaqim. Mais Néko prit Joachaz, le frère d’Éliaqim, et l’emmena en Égypte.
fr.R: Le roi d’Égypte a fait roi de Juda et de Jérusalem Éliaqim, le frère de Joachaz. Il a changé le nom d’Éliaqim en Joïaqim. Néko a emmené Joachaz, le frère du nouveau roi, en Égypte.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Misri akamtawaza Eliakimu nduguye kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu, akabadilisha jina lake [kuwa] Yehoyakimu; naye Yehoahazi nduguye Neko akamchukua, akampeleka [mpaka] Misri.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Misri alimtawaza Eliakimu, nduguye Yehoahazi, kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu, akabadilisha jina la Eliakimu kuwa Yehoyakimu. Lakini Neko akamchukua Yehoahazi, nduguye Eliakimu, akampeleka Misri.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Misri alimfanya Eliakimu, nduguye Yehoahazi, kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu. Akabadilisha jina la Eliakimu kuwa Yehoyakimu. Neko akamchukua Yehoahazi, nduguye mfalme mpya, akampeleka Misri.

vi.L: Vua Ai Cập lập Ê-li-a-kim, anh em của ông, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, và đổi tên ông ấy [thành] Giê-hô-gia-kim; còn Giô-a-cha, anh em của ông ấy, thì Nê-cô bắt đem [sang] Ai Cập.
vi.B: Vua Ai Cập lập Ê-li-a-kim, anh của Giô-a-cha, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, và đổi tên Ê-li-a-kim thành Giê-hô-gia-kim. Còn Giô-a-cha, em của Ê-li-a-kim, thì bị Nê-cô bắt đem sang Ai Cập.
vi.R: Vua Ai Cập lập Ê-li-a-kim, anh của Giô-a-cha, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy đổi tên Ê-li-a-kim thành Giê-hô-gia-kim. Nê-cô bắt Giô-a-cha, em của vị vua mới, đem sang Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 이집트 왕이 그의 형제 엘리아김을 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 삼고, 그의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 그리고 그의 형제 여호아하스는 느고가 데려가서 이집트로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 이집트 왕은 여호아하스의 형제 엘리아김을 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 세우고, 엘리아김의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 그러나 느고는 엘리아김의 형제 여호아하스를 이집트로 끌고 갔다.
ko.R: 이집트 왕은 여호아하스의 형제 엘리아김을 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 세웠다. 그는 엘리아김의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 느고는 새 왕의 형제 여호아하스를 이집트로 끌고 갔다.

pt.L: E o rei do Egito fez Eliaquim, seu irmão, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém, e mudou o seu nome [para] Jeoaquim; e Jeoacaz, seu irmão, Neco tomou e o levou [para o] Egito.
pt.B: O rei do Egito fez Eliaquim, irmão de Jeoacaz, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém, e mudou o nome de Eliaquim para Jeoaquim. Mas Neco tomou Jeoacaz, irmão de Eliaquim, e o levou para o Egito.
pt.R: O rei do Egito fez Eliaquim, irmão de Jeoacaz, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém. Ele mudou o nome de Eliaquim para Jeoaquim. Neco levou Jeoacaz, irmão do novo rei, para o Egito.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 23:34, told from the point of view of the two brothers
decisions.reason: Kings says Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim "son of Josiah" king "in place of Josiah his father", and that Jehoahaz "came to Egypt and died there". Chronicles calls Eliakim "his brother", that is, Jehoahaz's brother, says he was made king "over Judah and Jerusalem", and says only that Neco brought Jehoahaz to Egypt, without his death there.

decisions.choice: Eliakim, Jehoiakim: a new name given by the overlord
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 23:34, the two names mean almost the same, "God raises up" and "Yahweh raises up". A ruler who renamed a king showed that the king reigned by his will (verse 10; 2 Kings 24:17).

decisions.choice: his brother ... his brother: the two sons of Josiah
decisions.reason: The first "his brother" makes Eliakim the brother of Jehoahaz; the second makes Jehoahaz the brother of Eliakim. The Hebrew puts Jehoahaz first in the second clause to set his fate against Eliakim's rise.

decisions.choice: the brother of Jehoahaz; Eliakim's name; the new king's brother
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the brothers for the pronouns so the reader can follow who is who (m3). Balanced keeps the contrast with "But".

decisions.choice: "anh của Giô-a-cha"; "em của Ê-li-a-kim"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say who is older; Jehoiakim was twenty-five when he began to reign (verse 5), soon after Jehoahaz at twenty-three (verse 2), so he was the elder.

decisions.choice: Eliaquim; Jeoaquim; Neco (without "Faraó"); irmão de Jeoacaz, irmão de Eliaquim (B)
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms 2 Kings 23:34 sets (m2); Chronicles says "Neco" alone, so there is no "Faraó". Balanced and Readable name the brothers for the two "his brother", as the English does (m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with Jehoahaz set first in the second clause.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָרַ֔ע בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and five year[s] [was] Jehoiakim when he became king, and one [and] ten year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh his God.

en.L: A son of twenty-five years [was] Jehoiakim when he became king, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem; and he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.B: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.R: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God said was evil.

es.L: Hijo de veinticinco años [era] Joacim cuando comenzó a reinar, y once años reinó en Jerusalén; e hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Joacim tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó once años en Jerusalén. Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Joacim tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante once años. Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios reprueba.

fr.L: Joïaqim [avait] vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem ; et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.B: Joïaqim avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem. Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.R: Joïaqim avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant onze ans. Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu déclare mauvais.

sw.L: Yehoyakimu [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na mmoja alitawala huko Yerusalemu; naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.B: Yehoyakimu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.R: Yehoyakimu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja. Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-kim [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem; vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kim được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kim được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười một năm. Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, cho là ác.

ko.L: 여호야김이 왕이 되었을 때 25세[였고], 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 여호야김은 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 여호야김은 25세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: Jeoaquim [tinha] vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e onze anos reinou em Jerusalém; e fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.B: Jeoaquim tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém. Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.R: Jeoaquim tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante onze anos. Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, considerava mau.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 23:36-37, with "his God" added and his mother left out
decisions.reason: The age and the length of the reign are those of 2 Kings 23:36. Chronicles leaves out his mother, Zebudah, and gives the verdict in a shorter form, with "Yahweh his God" where Kings says "Yahweh" and adds "according to all that his fathers had done".

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh his God: the verdict on his reign
decisions.reason: "His God" sharpens the charge: the king did evil against the God who was his own. Jeremiah tells of his reign: he burned the scroll of Jeremiah's words (Jeremiah 36:23) and built his palace with unpaid labor (Jeremiah 22:13-19).

decisions.choice: the accession and verdict formulas
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 23:36-37: the formulas are worded the same way at each level in Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR ... reprueba" (R)
decisions.reason: The accession and verdict formulas as the terms note sets them, with "su Dios" as the Hebrew of Chronicles adds (m1).

decisions.choice: the accession and verdict formulas of 2 Kings 23:36-37, with "o seu Deus"
decisions.reason: Both formulas keep the Portuguese of 2 Kings 23:36-37 at each level, without the mother and Kings' "como os seus antepassados tinham feito", and with "o seu Deus" added, as Chronicles has it (m1, m2).

records.literal_gloss: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he bound him with the bronze [fetters] to take him [to] Babylon.

en.L: Against him Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and he bound him in bronze [chains] to take him [to] Babylon.
en.B: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him and put him in bronze chains to take him off to Babylon.
en.R: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked Jehoiakim. He put him in bronze chains to take him to Babylon.

es.L: Contra él subió Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y lo ató con [cadenas de] bronce para llevarlo [a] Babilonia.
es.B: Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia subió contra él y lo ató con cadenas de bronce para llevárselo a Babilonia.
es.R: Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia atacó a Joacim. Lo ató con cadenas de bronce para llevárselo a Babilonia.

fr.L: Contre lui monta Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et il le lia de [chaînes de] bronze pour l’emmener [à] Babylone.
fr.B: Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, monta contre lui et le lia de chaînes de bronze pour l’emmener à Babylone.
fr.R: Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, a attaqué Joïaqim. Il l’a attaché avec des chaînes de bronze pour l’emmener à Babylone.

sw.L: Juu yake Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akapanda, akamfunga kwa [minyororo ya] shaba ili kumpeleka [mpaka] Babeli.
sw.B: Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alipanda kumshambulia, akamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba ili kumpeleka Babeli.
sw.R: Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alimshambulia Yehoyakimu. Akamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba ili kumpeleka Babeli.

vi.L: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đi lên đánh vua, và xiềng vua bằng [xích] đồng để giải vua [sang] Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn kéo lên đánh vua và xiềng vua bằng xích đồng để giải sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn tấn công Giê-hô-gia-kim. Vua ấy xiềng Giê-hô-gia-kim bằng xích đồng để giải sang Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그를 치러 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 올라와서, 그를 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 [사슬로] 묶었다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 그를 치러 올라와서, 그를 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 사슬로 묶었다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 여호야김을 공격했다. 그는 여호야김을 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 사슬로 묶었다.

pt.L: Contra ele subiu Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e o prendeu com [correntes de] bronze para levá-lo [para a] Babilônia.
pt.B: Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, subiu contra ele e o prendeu com correntes de bronze para levá-lo para a Babilônia.
pt.R: Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, atacou Jeoaquim. Ele o prendeu com correntes de bronze para levá-lo para a Babilônia.

decisions.choice: different from 2 Kings 24:1-6: Jehoiakim bound to be taken to Babylon
alternatives: he was taken to Babylon in chains
he was bound to be taken, but died or was released before he went
decisions.reason: Kings says that Nebuchadnezzar came up, that Jehoiakim served him three years and then rebelled, that Yahweh sent raiding bands against him, and that he "lay down with his fathers" (2 Kings 24:1-6). Chronicles says instead that Nebuchadnezzar bound him in bronze to take him to Babylon. It does not say that he was taken there, or how he died.

decisions.choice: bronze: a pair of bronze fetters
decisions.reason: The word for bronze is in the dual form, which is used for fetters or chains made of bronze, one for each hand or foot (Judges 16:21; 2 Kings 25:7).

decisions.choice: to take him: what Nebuchadnezzar meant to do
decisions.reason: The form states the purpose of binding him, not the outcome. Daniel 1:1-2 tells that in Jehoiakim's third year the king of Babylon took him and some of the temple vessels; Jeremiah 22:18-19 and 36:30 say his body would be thrown out, unburied, outside Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: chains
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "bronze" (m2). Literal supplies "[chains]" in brackets; Balanced and Readable say "bronze chains". Readable names Jehoiakim for "him" and says "attacked" for "came up against".

decisions.choice: "Nabucodonosor"; "[cadenas de] bronce" (L); "cadenas de bronce" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nebuchadnezzar as the terms note names him; the Hebrew says only "bronze" (m2), so Literal brackets the chains.

decisions.choice: Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia; [correntes de] bronze (L), correntes de bronze (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia" as 2 Kings 24:1 sets it; the bronze fetters (m2) are "correntes de bronze", as 33:11 and 2 Kings 25:7, bracketed at Literal as the English brackets "chains".

source.text: וּמִכְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֵבִ֥יא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר לְבָבֶ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּהֵיכָל֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And some of [the] vessels of [the] house of Yahweh brought Nebuchadnezzar to Babylon, and he put them in his temple in Babylon.

en.L: And some of the vessels of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} Nebuchadnezzar brought to Babylon, and he put them in his temple in Babylon.
en.B: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off to Babylon some of the vessels from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and placed them in his temple there.
en.R: Nebuchadnezzar also took some of the objects from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple to Babylon. He put them in his own temple there.

es.L: Y parte de los utensilios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los llevó Nabucodonosor a Babilonia, y los puso en su templo en Babilonia.
es.B: Nabucodonosor también llevó a Babilonia parte de los utensilios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los puso en su templo de allí.
es.R: Nabucodonosor también se llevó a Babilonia algunos de los objetos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Los puso en su propio templo, allá en Babilonia.

fr.L: Et une partie des objets de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Nabuchodonosor l’emporta à Babylone, et il les mit dans son temple à Babylone.
fr.B: Nabuchodonosor emporta aussi à Babylone une partie des objets de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les plaça dans son temple, là-bas.
fr.R: Nabuchodonosor a aussi emporté à Babylone une partie des objets du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il les a mis dans son propre temple, là-bas.

sw.L: Na baadhi ya vyombo vya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Nebukadneza akavipeleka Babeli, akaviweka katika hekalu lake huko Babeli.
sw.B: Nebukadneza alichukua pia baadhi ya vyombo vya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akavipeleka Babeli, akaviweka katika hekalu lake huko.
sw.R: Nebukadneza alichukua pia baadhi ya vitu vya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akavipeleka Babeli. Akaviweka katika hekalu lake mwenyewe huko.

vi.L: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa cũng đem một số vật dụng của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Ba-by-lôn và đặt trong đền thờ của mình tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa cũng đem một số vật dụng của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Ba-by-lôn và đặt trong đền thờ của mình tại đó.
vi.R: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa cũng lấy một số đồ vật trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem về Ba-by-lôn. Vua ấy đặt chúng trong đền thờ thần của mình tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 느부갓네살이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 기구들 가운데 얼마를 바빌론으로 가져가서, 바빌론에 있는 그의 신전에 두었다.
ko.B: 느부갓네살은 또 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 기구들 가운데 얼마를 바빌론으로 가져가서, 그곳에 있는 자기 신전에 두었다.
ko.R: 느부갓네살은 또 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 있던 물건들 가운데 얼마를 바빌론으로 가져갔다. 그는 그것들을 그곳에 있는 자기 신전에 두었다.

pt.L: E parte dos utensílios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} Nabucodonosor levou para a Babilônia, e os pôs no seu templo na Babilônia.
pt.B: Nabucodonosor também levou para a Babilônia parte dos utensílios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os colocou no seu templo lá.
pt.R: Nabucodonosor também levou para a Babilônia alguns objetos do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele os colocou no seu próprio templo lá.

decisions.choice: his temple: the temple of Nebuchadnezzar's god
decisions.reason: The word can mean a palace or a temple. Ezra 1:7 says Nebuchadnezzar put the vessels "in the house of his gods", and Daniel 1:2 says he brought them "to the house of his god", so a temple is meant. Putting a defeated people's sacred things in one's own temple displayed the victory of one's god.

decisions.choice: some of the vessels: the first of three removals
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells the temple's loss in three steps: some vessels under Jehoiakim, the precious vessels with Jehoiachin (verse 10), and all the rest when the city fell (verse 18). Cyrus gave them back (Ezra 1:7-11), and that return is foreshadowed in the decree that ends this chapter.

decisions.choice: vessels (Literal, Balanced); objects (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word covers bowls, utensils and other furnishings of the temple. Readable uses a more general word. Balanced and Readable say "there" for the second "in Babylon".

decisions.choice: utensílios (L, B), objetos (R); o seu templo
decisions.reason: The vessels keep the words 2 Kings 24:13 gives them in Portuguese, "utensílios" at Literal and Balanced and "objetos" at Readable, through verses 10 and 18, so the reader can follow the three removals (m2). The word that can mean palace or temple is "templo", as m1 reads it.

source.text: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהֽוֹיָקִ֜ים וְתֹֽעֲבֹתָ֤יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ וְהַנִּמְצָ֣א עָלָ֔יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jehoiakim and his abominations which he did and the [thing] found against him, look, they [are] written on [the] book of [the] kings of Israel and Judah; and reigned Jehoiachin his son in his place.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jehoiakim, and his abominations that he did, and what was found against him, look, they [are] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, the detestable things he did and what was found against him, are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. His son Jehoiachin became king in his place.
en.R: Everything else Jehoiakim did, the disgusting things he did and the wrong that was found in him, is written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. His son Jehoiachin became king after him.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Joacim, y sus abominaciones que hizo, y lo que se halló contra él, he aquí [están] escritos en el libro de los reyes de Israel y de Judá. Y reinó en su lugar Joaquín su hijo.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Joacim, las prácticas detestables que cometió y lo que se halló contra él, están escritos en el libro de los Reyes de Israel y de Judá. Su hijo Joaquín reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Joacim, las cosas repugnantes que hizo y el mal que se halló en él, está escrito en el libro de los reyes de Israel y de Judá. Su hijo Joaquín lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Joïaqim, et les abominations qu’il commit, et ce qui fut trouvé contre lui, voici, ils [sont] écrits dans le livre des rois d’Israël et de Juda. Et Joïakin son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Joïaqim, les pratiques abominables qu’il commit et ce qu’on trouva contre lui, est écrit dans le livre des Rois d’Israël et de Juda. Son fils Joïakin régna à sa place.
fr.R: Tout ce que Joïaqim a fait d’autre, les choses dégoûtantes qu’il a faites et le mal qu’on a trouvé en lui, a été écrit dans le livre des rois d’Israël et de Juda. Son fils Joïakin est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yehoyakimu, na machukizo yake aliyoyafanya, na yaliyoonekana juu yake, tazama, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda. Na Yehoyakini mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yehoyakimu, mambo ya kuchukiza aliyoyafanya na yale yaliyoonekana dhidi yake, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda. Na mwanawe Yehoyakini akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yehoyakimu, mambo ya kuchukiza aliyoyafanya na maovu yaliyoonekana ndani yake, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda. Na mwanawe Yehoyakini akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giê-hô-gia-kim, những điều ghê tởm vua đã làm, và những gì người ta thấy nghịch lại vua, kìa, đã được chép trong sách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Giê-hô-gia-kin con trai vua trị vì thay vua.
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giê-hô-gia-kim, những điều ghê tởm vua đã làm và những tội trạng của vua, đều được chép trong Sách Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Giê-hô-gia-kin con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giê-hô-gia-kim đã làm, những điều ghê tởm vua làm và những điều sai trái người ta thấy nơi vua, đều được chép trong sách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Giê-hô-gia-kin con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야김의 나머지 일들과 그가 행한 가증한 일들과 그에게서 드러난 것은, 보아라, 이스라엘과 유다 왕들의 책에 기록되어 있다. 그리고 그의 아들 여호야긴이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여호야김의 나머지 행적과 그가 저지른 역겨운 일들과 그에게서 드러난 죄는 이스라엘과 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다. 그의 아들 여호야긴이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여호야김이 한 다른 모든 일과 그가 저지른 끔찍한 일들과 그에게서 드러난 잘못은 이스라엘과 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 그의 아들 여호야긴이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Jeoaquim, e as suas abominações que ele fez, e o que se achou contra ele, eis que estão escritos no livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá. E Joaquim, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Jeoaquim, as coisas abomináveis que ele fez e o que se achou contra ele estão escritos no Livro dos Reis de Israel e de Judá. O seu filho Joaquim reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Jeoaquim fez, as coisas abomináveis que ele praticou e o mal que se encontrou nele, está escrito no livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá. O seu filho Joaquim se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: the sources formula of 2 Kings 24:5, with "his abominations" added
decisions.reason: Kings sends the reader to "the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah" for "all that he did". Chronicles names its own source, as elsewhere (27:7), and adds "his abominations that he did, and what was found against him". It also leaves out the formula of his death (2 Kings 24:6a) and goes straight to his son's reign.

decisions.choice: his abominations: practices Yahweh detests
decisions.reason: The word is used for what is utterly offensive to Yahweh, especially the worship of other gods (verse 14; 2 Kings 21:2). Chronicles does not say what they were.

decisions.choice: what was found against him: the guilt or charges proved against him
decisions.reason: To be "found against" or "in" someone is used of wrongdoing that comes to light (1 Kings 1:52; 1 Samuel 25:28). Here it sums up his guilt.

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin: also called Jeconiah and Coniah
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 24:6, the same king is called Jeconiah (1 Chronicles 3:16) and Coniah (Jeremiah 22:24).

decisions.choice: abominations / detestable things / disgusting things; the sources formula
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 21:2 for the word for abominations. The sources formula of Chronicles has "look" at Literal and a plain statement at Balanced and Readable, as in 27:7.

decisions.choice: "abominaciones" (L); "prácticas detestables" (B); "cosas repugnantes" (R); "Joaquín"
decisions.reason: As Spanish 2 Kings 21:2 renders the word at each level; Jehoiachin is "Joaquín", as the terms note writes him, kept apart from his father Joacim.

decisions.choice: "Joïaqim" and "Joïakin"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, which keep the two kings apart by their ending, as in French 2 Kings 24:6.

decisions.choice: abominações (L), coisas abomináveis (B, R); o que se achou contra ele (L, B); Joaquim
decisions.reason: The source note keeps the form 35:27 gives it at each level, with what Chronicles adds (m1); the abominations keep the words of 33:2 and 2 Kings 21:2 (m2). "Joaquim" as 2 Kings 24:6 sets it for Jehoiachin (m4), kept apart from his father "Jeoaquim".

source.text: בֶּן־שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנִים֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of eight years [was] Jehoiachin when he became king, and three months and ten days he reigned in Jerusalem; and he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh.

en.L: A son of eight years [was] Jehoiachin when he became king, and three months and ten days he reigned in Jerusalem; and he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for three months and ten days. He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil.

es.L: Hijo de ocho años [era] Joaquín cuando comenzó a reinar, y tres meses y diez días reinó en Jerusalén; e hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Joaquín tenía ocho años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó tres meses y diez días en Jerusalén. Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Joaquín tenía ocho años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante tres meses y diez días. Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba.

fr.L: Joïakin [avait] huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois et dix jours à Jérusalem ; et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Joïakin avait huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois et dix jours à Jérusalem. Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Joïakin avait huit ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trois mois et dix jours. Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais.

sw.L: Yehoyakini [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala, na miezi mitatu na siku kumi alitawala huko Yerusalemu; naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Yehoyakini alikuwa na umri wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miezi mitatu na siku kumi huko Yerusalemu. Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Yehoyakini alikuwa na umri wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miezi mitatu na siku kumi. Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-kin [được] tám tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì ba tháng mười ngày tại Giê-ru-sa-lem; vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kin được tám tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì ba tháng mười ngày tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin được tám tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba tháng mười ngày. Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác.

ko.L: 여호야긴이 왕이 되었을 때 8세[였고], 예루살렘에서 석 달 열흘 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 여호야긴은 8세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 석 달 열흘 동안 다스렸다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 여호야긴은 8세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 석 달 열흘 동안 다스렸다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: Joaquim [tinha] oito anos quando começou a reinar, e três meses e dez dias reinou em Jerusalém; e fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Joaquim tinha oito anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou três meses e dez dias em Jerusalém. Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Joaquim tinha oito anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante três meses e dez dias. Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau.

decisions.choice: eight years old: the Hebrew text of Chronicles
alternatives: eighteen years old, as in 2 Kings 24:8
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 24:8 says Jehoiachin was eighteen years old, and the mention of his wives in 2 Kings 24:15 fits the older age. Some ancient translations of Chronicles have eighteen here. The difference may come from a copying slip in Chronicles, where the word for "ten" dropped out. The Hebrew of Chronicles is followed, since that is the text being translated.

decisions.choice: three months and ten days: more exact than 2 Kings 24:8
decisions.reason: Kings gives three months; Chronicles adds ten days. Chronicles also leaves out his mother, Nehushta, and the words "according to all that his father had done" (2 Kings 24:9).

decisions.choice: the accession and verdict formulas
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 24:8-9: the formulas are worded the same way at each level, with the numbers of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "tám tuổi"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of Chronicles has eight (m1); the Vietnamese follows it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "8세", the age the Hebrew of Chronicles gives
decisions.reason: The text follows the Hebrew of Chronicles, as the English does; the meaning decisions note the difference from Kings.

decisions.choice: oito anos; três meses e dez dias
decisions.reason: The formulas keep the Portuguese of 2 Kings 24:8-9 at each level, with the numbers of the Hebrew of Chronicles, "oito" and "três meses e dez dias", as the English keeps them; the meaning note gives Kings' "dezoito" (m1, m2).

source.text: וְלִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֗ה שָׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֔ר וַיְבִאֵ֣הוּ בָבֶ֔לָה עִם־כְּלֵ֖י חֶמְדַּ֣ת בֵּית־יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּמְלֵךְ֙ אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָחִ֔יו עַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] return of the year sent King Nebuchadnezzar and brought him [to] Babylon, with [the] vessels of preciousness of [the] house of Yahweh; and he made king Zedekiah his brother over Judah and Jerusalem.

en.L: And at the turn of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him [to] Babylon, with the precious vessels of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and he made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
en.B: In the spring of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and brought him to Babylon, along with the precious vessels of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He made Jehoiachin's relative Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
en.R: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for Jehoiachin and had him brought to Babylon. He also took the valuable objects from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. Then he made Zedekiah, a relative of Jehoiachin, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

es.L: Y a la vuelta del año, el rey Nabucodonosor envió y lo hizo llevar [a] Babilonia, con los utensilios preciosos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y puso por rey a Sedequías su hermano sobre Judá y Jerusalén.
es.B: En la primavera, el rey Nabucodonosor mandó que lo llevaran a Babilonia, junto con los utensilios preciosos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. E hizo rey sobre Judá y Jerusalén a Sedequías, pariente de Joaquín.
es.R: En la primavera, el rey Nabucodonosor mandó buscar a Joaquín y lo hizo llevar a Babilonia. También se llevó los objetos valiosos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Luego hizo rey sobre Judá y Jerusalén a Sedequías, un pariente de Joaquín.

fr.L: Et au retour de l’année, le roi Nabuchodonosor envoya [des gens] et le fit amener [à] Babylone, avec les objets précieux de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et il fit roi Sédécias, son frère, sur Juda et Jérusalem.
fr.B: Au printemps, le roi Nabuchodonosor le fit chercher et amener à Babylone, avec les objets précieux de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il établit roi sur Juda et Jérusalem Sédécias, un parent de Joïakin.
fr.R: Au printemps, le roi Nabuchodonosor a envoyé chercher Joïakin et l’a fait amener à Babylone. Il a aussi pris les objets de valeur du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Puis il a fait roi de Juda et de Jérusalem Sédécias, un parent de Joïakin.

sw.L: Na mwaka ulipogeuka, mfalme Nebukadneza akatuma, akamleta [mpaka] Babeli, pamoja na vyombo vya thamani vya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; akamtawaza Sedekia nduguye kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Wakati wa majira ya kuchipua mfalme Nebukadneza alituma watu wamlete Babeli, pamoja na vyombo vya thamani vya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akamtawaza Sedekia, jamaa ya Yehoyakini, kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Wakati wa majira ya kuchipua, mfalme Nebukadneza alituma watu wamlete Yehoyakini Babeli. Akachukua pia vitu vya thamani vya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha akamfanya Sedekia, jamaa ya Yehoyakini, kuwa mfalme juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Vào lúc năm mới, vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa sai [người] đem vua về Ba-by-lôn, cùng với các vật dụng quý giá của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và lập Sê-đê-kia, anh em của vua, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào mùa xuân năm ấy, vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa sai người đem vua về Ba-by-lôn, cùng với các vật dụng quý giá của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua ấy lập Sê-đê-kia, người bà con của Giê-hô-gia-kin, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vào mùa xuân, vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa sai người bắt Giê-hô-gia-kin đem về Ba-by-lôn. Vua ấy cũng lấy các đồ vật quý trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi vua ấy lập Sê-đê-kia, một người bà con của Giê-hô-gia-kin, làm vua cai trị Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 해가 바뀔 때에 느부갓네살 왕이 [사람을] 보내어, 그를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 귀한 기구들과 함께 바빌론으로 데려갔다. 그리고 그의 형제 시드기야를 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 봄이 되자 느부갓네살 왕이 사람을 보내어, 그를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 귀한 기구들과 함께 바빌론으로 데려갔다. 그리고 여호야긴의 친척 시드기야를 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 봄이 되자 느부갓네살 왕은 사람을 보내어 여호야긴을 바빌론으로 끌고 가게 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 있던 값진 물건들도 가져갔다. 그리고 여호야긴의 친척인 시드기야를 유다와 예루살렘의 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E na volta do ano o rei Nabucodonosor mandou e o trouxe [para a] Babilônia, com os utensílios preciosos da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e fez Zedequias, seu irmão, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém.
pt.B: Na primavera, o rei Nabucodonosor mandou buscá-lo e o levou para a Babilônia, junto com os utensílios preciosos da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. E fez Zedequias, parente de Joaquim, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém.
pt.R: Na primavera, o rei Nabucodonosor mandou buscar Joaquim e o levou para a Babilônia. Também levou os objetos de valor do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Depois fez Zedequias, um parente de Joaquim, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: at the turn of the year: in the spring
decisions.reason: The year "returns" in spring, the season when kings went out to war (2 Samuel 11:1; 1 Kings 20:22, 26). Babylon's own records date the capture of Jerusalem to early 597 BC.

decisions.choice: a short form of 2 Kings 24:10-17
decisions.reason: Kings tells of the siege, Jehoiachin's surrender with his mother and court, the treasures taken and the ten thousand exiles, and the renaming of Mattaniah as Zedekiah. Chronicles tells only that the king and the precious vessels were taken to Babylon and that Zedekiah was made king.

decisions.choice: his brother: his relative
alternatives: his brother, a son of Jehoiakim (1 Chronicles 3:16)
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 24:17 says Zedekiah was Jehoiachin's uncle, a son of Josiah (1 Chronicles 3:15). The word "brother" can mean any male relative (Genesis 14:16; 29:15). 1 Chronicles 3:16 also names a Zedekiah son of Jehoiakim, who would have been Jehoiachin's brother, but the king of verse 11 is twenty-one, the same age as Josiah's son in 2 Kings 24:18.

decisions.choice: his brother (Literal); relative (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word. Balanced and Readable say "relative", which is true on either view of who Zedekiah was (m3), and name Jehoiachin for "his".

decisions.choice: in the spring
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the turn of the year" means (m1).

decisions.choice: "En la primavera" (B, R); "su hermano" (L); "pariente" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the turn of the year" means (m1) and say "pariente", which is true on either view of who Zedekiah was (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "un parent de Joïakin"
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable say "relative", which fits either view of who Zedekiah was (m3); Literal keeps "son frère".

decisions.choice: jamaa ya Yehoyakini
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "nduguye" (his brother); Balanced and Readable say "jamaa" (relative), since Zedekiah was Jehoiachin's uncle (2 Kings 24:17).

decisions.choice: na volta do ano (L), na primavera (B, R); seu irmão (L), parente de Joaquim (B, R); Zedequias
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom of the year's turn, and Balanced and Readable say the season (m1), as the English does. "Irmão" is kept at Literal, and Balanced and Readable say "parente", true on either reading of m3. "Zedequias" as 2 Kings 24:17 sets it.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַחַ֛ת שָׁנָ֖ה צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and one year[s] [was] Zedekiah when he became king, and one [and] ten year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: A son of twenty-one years [was] Zedekiah when he became king, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem.
en.B: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
en.R: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years.

es.L: Hijo de veintiún años [era] Sedequías cuando comenzó a reinar, y once años reinó en Jerusalén.
es.B: Sedequías tenía veintiún años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó once años en Jerusalén.
es.R: Sedequías tenía veintiún años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante once años.

fr.L: Sédécias [avait] vingt et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant onze ans.

sw.L: Sedekia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na mmoja alitawala huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na mmoja huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja.

vi.L: Sê-đê-kia [được] hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sê-đê-kia được hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sê-đê-kia được hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười một năm.

ko.L: 시드기야가 왕이 되었을 때 21세[였고], 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 시드기야는 21세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 시드기야는 21세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 11년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: Zedequias [tinha] vinte e um anos quando começou a reinar, e onze anos reinou em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Zedequias tinha vinte e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Zedequias tinha vinte e um anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante onze anos.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 24:18 without the name of his mother
decisions.reason: The age and the length of the reign are the same as in 2 Kings 24:18 and Jeremiah 52:1. Chronicles leaves out his mother, Hamutal.

decisions.choice: eleven years: from 597 BC to the fall of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 24:18: Zedekiah reigned until the city fell in his eleventh year, about 586 BC (2 Kings 25:2).

decisions.choice: the accession formula worded as in 2 Kings 24:18
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording from 2 Kings 24:18.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 24:18, without the queen mother
decisions.reason: The accession formula of 2 Kings 24:18 in Portuguese at each level, ending at "Jerusalém", since Chronicles leaves out Hamutal (m1).

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָרַ֔ע בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו לֹ֣א נִכְנַ֗ע מִלִּפְנֵ֛י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא מִפִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh his God; not he humbled himself from before Jeremiah the prophet from [the] mouth of Yahweh.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God; he did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet [speaking] from the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. He did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke the word that came from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God said was evil. Jeremiah the prophet spoke to him with words from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but Zedekiah would not humble himself before him.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios; no se humilló delante del profeta Jeremías, [que le hablaba] de la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. No se humilló delante del profeta Jeremías, que le comunicaba la palabra que venía {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios reprueba. El profeta Jeremías le habló con palabras que venían {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, pero Sedequías no quiso humillarse delante de él.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu ; il ne s’humilia pas devant Jérémie le prophète, [qui parlait] de la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu. Il ne s’humilia pas devant le prophète Jérémie, qui lui transmettait la parole venue {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu déclare mauvais. Le prophète Jérémie lui a parlé avec des paroles qui venaient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais Sédécias n’a pas voulu s’humilier devant lui.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake; hakujinyenyekeza mbele ya Yeremia nabii [aliyesema] kutoka kinywani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. Hakujinyenyekeza mbele ya nabii Yeremia, aliyesema neno lililotoka kinywani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Nabii Yeremia alisema naye maneno kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini Sedekia hakukubali kujinyenyekeza mbele yake.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua; vua không hạ mình trước nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi, [người nói] từ miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua. Vua không hạ mình trước nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi, là người nói lời đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, cho là ác. Nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi nói với vua những lời từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng Sê-đê-kia không chịu hạ mình trước ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입에서 [나온 말씀을 전하는] 예언자 예레미야 앞에서 자신을 낮추지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 말씀을 전한 예언자 예레미야 앞에서 자신을 낮추지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 예언자 예레미야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 그에게 전했지만, 시드기야는 예레미야 앞에서 겸손해지지 않았다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus; não se humilhou diante de Jeremias, o profeta, [que falava] da boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus. Não se humilhou diante do profeta Jeremias, que lhe falava a palavra que vinha {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, considerava mau. O profeta Jeremias falou com ele com palavras que vinham {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas Zedequias não quis se humilhar diante dele.

decisions.choice: the verdict of 2 Kings 24:19, with a charge added
decisions.reason: Kings says he did evil "according to all that Jehoiakim had done". Chronicles says "Yahweh his God" and adds that he did not humble himself before Jeremiah. Chronicles often judges a king by whether he humbled himself before Yahweh (7:14; 12:6-7; 33:12, 23; 34:27).

decisions.choice: did not humble himself before Jeremiah: refused to submit to the word Jeremiah brought
decisions.reason: To humble oneself before a prophet is to submit to the God who speaks through him. The book of Jeremiah tells how Zedekiah asked for Yahweh's word and heard it, yet did not obey it (Jeremiah 37:1-2, 17; 38:14-23).

decisions.choice: from the mouth of Yahweh: with words that came from Yahweh
decisions.reason: The prophet spoke what Yahweh's mouth had spoken. Jeremiah's words were not his own opinion, so refusing them was refusing Yahweh.

decisions.choice: [speaking] (Literal); who spoke the word that came from (Balanced); spoke to him with words from (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets "from the mouth of Yahweh" after the prophet's name without a verb. Literal supplies "[speaking]"; Balanced and Readable make it a clause. Readable puts Jeremiah's message first so that the refusal follows it.

decisions.choice: não se humilhou (every level); Jeremias, o profeta
decisions.reason: "Humilhar-se" is the word of 7:14, 33:12, 33:23 and 34:27 in Portuguese, so the last king is measured by it as the Chronicler measures the others (m1, m2). Literal brackets the verb the Hebrew leaves out before "da boca do SENHOR" (m3), as the English does.

source.text: וְ֠גַם בַּמֶּ֤לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מָרָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיע֖וֹ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיֶּ֤קֶשׁ אֶת־עָרְפּוֹ֙ וַיְאַמֵּ֣ץ אֶת־לְבָב֔וֹ מִשּׁ֕וּב אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And also against the king Nebuchadnezzar he rebelled, who had made him swear by God; and he stiffened his neck and made hard his heart from turning to Yahweh [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And also against King Nebuchadnezzar he rebelled, who had made him swear by God; and he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart from turning to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel.
en.B: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear an oath by God. He stiffened his neck and hardened his heart, and would not turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, even though Nebuchadnezzar had made him promise in God's name to be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn. He made up his mind not to turn back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y también se rebeló contra el rey Nabucodonosor, que lo había hecho jurar por Dios; y endureció su cerviz y obstinó su corazón para no volverse {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.B: También se rebeló contra el rey Nabucodonosor, que le había hecho jurar por Dios. Endureció su cerviz y obstinó su corazón, y no quiso volverse {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: También se rebeló contra el rey Nabucodonosor, aunque Nabucodonosor le había hecho prometer en el nombre de Dios que le sería leal. Sedequías era terco. Se empeñó en no volverse {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et il se révolta aussi contre le roi Nabuchodonosor, qui l’avait fait jurer par Dieu ; et il raidit sa nuque et endurcit son cœur pour ne pas revenir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Il se révolta aussi contre le roi Nabuchodonosor, qui lui avait fait prêter serment par Dieu. Il raidit sa nuque et endurcit son cœur, et refusa de revenir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Il s’est aussi révolté contre le roi Nabuchodonosor, alors que Nabuchodonosor lui avait fait promettre au nom de Dieu de lui rester fidèle. Sédécias était têtu. Il était décidé à ne pas revenir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Tena akamwasi mfalme Nebukadneza, aliyekuwa amemwapisha kwa Mungu; akaifanya shingo yake kuwa ngumu, akaufanya moyo wake kuwa mgumu asimgeukie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Pia alimwasi mfalme Nebukadneza, aliyekuwa amemwapisha kwa jina la Mungu. Akaifanya shingo yake kuwa ngumu na moyo wake kuwa mgumu, wala hakukubali kumgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Pia alimwasi mfalme Nebukadneza, ingawa Nebukadneza alikuwa amemfanya aahidi kwa jina la Mungu kwamba atakuwa mwaminifu kwake. Sedekia alikuwa mkaidi. Aliamua kutomrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vua cũng nổi loạn chống lại vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa, là người đã bắt vua thề nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời; vua cứng cổ và cứng lòng, không quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vua cũng nổi loạn chống lại vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa, là người đã bắt vua thề nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời. Vua cứng cổ, cứng lòng, và không chịu quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vua cũng nổi loạn chống lại vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa, dù Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa đã bắt vua nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời mà hứa sẽ trung thành. Sê-đê-kia rất cứng đầu. Vua quyết không quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 하나님을 두고 그에게 맹세하게 한 느부갓네살 왕에게도 반역했다. 그리고 그가 그의 목을 곧게 하고 그의 마음을 완고하게 하여, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 또 하나님을 두고 맹세하게 한 느부갓네살 왕에게 반역했다. 그는 목을 곧게 하고 마음을 완고하게 하여, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 또 느부갓네살 왕에게 반역했다. 느부갓네살은 그에게 하나님의 이름으로 충성하겠다고 맹세하게 했었는데도 그랬다. 시드기야는 고집이 셌다. 그는 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오지 않기로 마음을 굳혔다.

pt.L: E também contra o rei Nabucodonosor se rebelou, o qual o tinha feito jurar por Deus; e endureceu a sua cerviz e tornou duro o seu coração para não se voltar {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.B: Ele também se rebelou contra o rei Nabucodonosor, que o tinha feito jurar por Deus. Endureceu a cerviz e o coração e não quis se voltar {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.R: Ele também se rebelou contra o rei Nabucodonosor, mesmo depois de Nabucodonosor tê-lo feito prometer em nome de Deus que seria leal. Zedequias foi teimoso. Ele decidiu que não ia voltar {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.

decisions.choice: rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: 2 Kings 24:20 and Ezekiel 17
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 24:20 says only that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon. Chronicles adds that he had sworn an oath by God. Ezekiel 17:13-19 says the same: the king of Babylon made a covenant with him and put him under oath, and by breaking it Zedekiah despised an oath sworn before Yahweh.

decisions.choice: stiffened his neck: refused to submit, as a stubborn animal will not bend to the yoke
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox that will not bow its neck. Yahweh called Israel "a stiff-necked people" in the wilderness (Exodus 32:9; 33:3), and 30:8 urges, "do not stiffen your neck".

decisions.choice: hardened his heart from turning: set his will against returning
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of the will. To make it hard "from turning" is to refuse to turn back to Yahweh (Deuteronomy 2:30; 15:7). The call to turn is the call of 7:14 and 30:6-9.

decisions.choice: promise in God's name to be loyal
decisions.reason: Readable says what the oath was about: loyalty to Nebuchadnezzar (Ezekiel 17:13-14). It also explains the two pictures of m2 and m3 as "was stubborn" and "made up his mind".

decisions.choice: and would not turn (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced turns "from turning" into a plain refusal, keeping the two pictures of the neck and the heart.

decisions.choice: "endureció su cerviz y obstinó su corazón" (L, B); "era terco. Se empeñó en no volverse" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the two pictures of the neck and the heart, as at 30:8; Readable says what they mean (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "목을 곧게 하고" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The picture of the stiff neck is kept as at 30:8, with "마음을 완고하게 하여" for the hardened heart; Readable says "고집이 셌다".

decisions.choice: endureceu a sua cerviz (L), endureceu a cerviz (B), foi teimoso (R)
decisions.reason: The stiff neck (m2) keeps the words of 30:8 in Portuguese at each level, "endurecer a cerviz" at Literal and Balanced and "teimoso" at Readable, so the reader hears Hezekiah's call refused. Balanced joins neck and heart under the one verb, as Portuguese avoids repeating "endureceu".

source.text: גַּ֠ם כָּל־שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהָעָם֙ הִרְבּ֣וּ לִמְעָול־מַ֔עַלכְּכֹ֖ל תֹּעֲב֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְדִּ֖ישׁ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Also all [the] leaders of the priests and the people multiplied to act unfaithfully [with] unfaithfulness according to all [the] abominations of the nations, and they defiled [the] house of Yahweh which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.

en.L: Also all the leaders of the priests and the people acted more and more unfaithfully, according to all the abominations of the nations; and they defiled the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had consecrated in Jerusalem.
en.B: In the same way all the leaders of the priests and the people were more and more unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations, and they defiled the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had set apart as holy in Jerusalem.
en.R: The leaders of the priests and the people also became more and more unfaithful to God. They copied all the disgusting things the nations did. They made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple in Jerusalem unclean, the temple {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made holy.

es.L: También todos los jefes de los sacerdotes y el pueblo multiplicaron su infidelidad, conforme a todas las abominaciones de las naciones; y contaminaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había santificado en Jerusalén.
es.B: Asimismo, todos los jefes de los sacerdotes y el pueblo fueron cada vez más infieles, siguiendo todas las prácticas detestables de las naciones, y contaminaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había consagrado en Jerusalén.
es.R: Los jefes de los sacerdotes y el pueblo también fueron cada vez más infieles a Dios. Imitaron todas las cosas repugnantes que hacían las naciones. Hicieron impuro el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, el templo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hecho santo.

fr.L: De plus, tous les chefs des prêtres et le peuple multiplièrent les infidélités, selon toutes les abominations des nations, et ils souillèrent la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait consacrée à Jérusalem.
fr.B: De même, tous les chefs des prêtres et le peuple furent de plus en plus infidèles, en suivant toutes les pratiques abominables des nations, et ils souillèrent la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait consacrée à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Les chefs des prêtres et le peuple ont aussi été de plus en plus infidèles à Dieu. Ils ont imité toutes les choses dégoûtantes que faisaient les nations. Ils ont rendu impur le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, le temple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait rendu saint.

sw.L: Pia viongozi wote wa makuhani na watu wakazidi kukosa uaminifu, sawasawa na machukizo yote ya mataifa; wakaitia unajisi nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoitakasa huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo viongozi wote wa makuhani na watu walizidi kukosa uaminifu, wakifuata desturi zote za kuchukiza za mataifa, nao wakaitia unajisi nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoiweka wakfu huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Viongozi wa makuhani na watu nao walizidi kukosa uaminifu kwa Mungu. Waliiga mambo yote ya kuchukiza yaliyofanywa na mataifa. Walilitia unajisi hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu, hekalu alilolifanya kuwa takatifu.

vi.L: Tất cả các người lãnh đạo của các thầy tế lễ và dân chúng cũng càng thêm bất trung, theo mọi điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc; họ làm ô uế nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thánh hóa tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, tất cả các người lãnh đạo của các thầy tế lễ và dân chúng ngày càng bất trung hơn, theo mọi thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc, và họ làm ô uế nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã biệt riêng ra thánh tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Các người lãnh đạo của các thầy tế lễ và dân chúng cũng ngày càng bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời. Họ bắt chước mọi điều ghê tởm các dân tộc khác làm. Họ làm ô uế đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên thánh.

ko.L: 또 제사장들의 모든 지도자와 백성이 민족들의 모든 가증한 일을 따라 신의를 크게 저버렸고, 그분께서 예루살렘에서 거룩하게 하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 더럽혔다.
ko.B: 제사장들의 모든 지도자와 백성도 이와 같이 민족들의 온갖 역겨운 관습을 따라 점점 더 신의를 저버렸다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘에 거룩하게 구별하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 더럽혔다.
ko.R: 제사장들의 지도자들과 백성도 점점 더 하나님께 신실하지 못했다. 그들은 다른 민족들이 하던 끔찍한 일들을 그대로 따라 했다. 그들은 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 더럽혔다. 그 성전은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 거룩하게 하신 곳이었다.

pt.L: Também todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e o povo cometeram mais e mais infidelidades, conforme todas as abominações das nações; e contaminaram a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha consagrado em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Da mesma forma, todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e o povo foram cada vez mais infiéis, seguindo todas as coisas abomináveis das nações, e tornaram impura a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha consagrado em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Os chefes dos sacerdotes e o povo também foram cada vez mais infiéis a Deus. Eles imitaram as coisas abomináveis que as nações faziam. Tornaram impuro o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, o templo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha feito santo.

decisions.choice: multiplied unfaithfulness: broke faith with Yahweh more and more
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun are the same word for breaking faith, used together for stress, with "multiplied" before them. Chronicles uses this word for the sin that brings disaster and exile (1 Chronicles 5:25; 9:1; 10:13; 2 Chronicles 12:2; 28:19). The letters written in the text and the form read aloud spell the verb a little differently, with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: the leaders of the priests and the people: leaders of both, or leading priests together with the people
decisions.reason: "Leaders" may govern both nouns, "the leaders of the priests and of the people", or only the priests, with "the people" as a second subject. Either way, both the religious leaders and the whole nation share the king's guilt.

decisions.choice: they defiled the house that Yahweh had consecrated: undoing what Hezekiah and Josiah had cleansed
decisions.reason: Yahweh had made the house holy for his name (7:16). Hezekiah had cleansed it (29:15-19) and Josiah had purged the land (34:3-8); now it was made unclean again by the practices of the nations.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered "princes" at Literal here names the heads of the priests, so every level says "leaders".

decisions.choice: abominations / detestable practices / disgusting things
decisions.reason: As in verse 8 and 2 Kings 21:2. Readable adds "to God" after "unfaithful" to say whom they betrayed.

decisions.choice: "los jefes" (every level)
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered "príncipes" at Literal here names the heads of the priests, so every level says "jefes", as the English says "leaders".

decisions.choice: infidelidades (L), infiéis (B, R); contaminaram (L), tornaram impura (B, R)
decisions.reason: The breach of faith (m1) keeps "infidelidade", the word of 33:19 and 1 Chronicles 10:13 in Portuguese. Defiling the temple is "contaminar" at Literal and "tornar impuro" at Balanced and Readable, as 2 Kings 23:8 has it, the word for ritual uncleanness (m3).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֡ח יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֧ם עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּיַ֥ד מַלְאָכָ֖יו הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְשָׁל֑וֹחַ כִּֽי־חָמַ֥ל עַל־עַמּ֖וֹ וְעַל־מְעוֹנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Yahweh [the] God of their fathers to them by [the] hand of his messengers, rising early and sending, for he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their fathers, sent to them by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messengers, rising early and sending, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had compassion on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, sent word to them through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messengers again and again, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} felt compassion for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling place.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, sent messengers to warn them. He sent them over and over, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} felt pity for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and for the place {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres, les envió [aviso] por mano de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajeros, madrugando y enviando, porque tenía compasión de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada.
