es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, les envió aviso una y otra vez por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajeros, porque tenía compasión de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, les envió mensajeros para advertirles. Los envió muchas veces, porque sentía compasión de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y del lugar que había hecho {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères, leur envoya [des avertissements] par la main de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messagers, se levant de bonne heure et envoyant, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, leur envoya sans cesse des avertissements par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messagers, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, leur a envoyé des messagers pour les avertir. Il les a envoyés encore et encore, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et de l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait choisi d’habiter.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zao, akatuma kwao kwa mkono wa wajumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akiamka mapema na kutuma, kwa maana aliwahurumia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na maskani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, aliwatumia ujumbe kupitia wajumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} tena na tena, kwa sababu aliwahurumia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, aliwatuma wajumbe kuwaonya. Aliwatuma tena na tena, kwa sababu aliwaonea huruma watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na mahali alipopafanya kuwa makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ, sai [người] đến với họ qua tay các sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, dậy sớm mà sai đi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, cứ liên tục sai các sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với họ, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, sai các sứ giả đến cảnh cáo họ. Ngài sai họ đến hết lần này đến lần khác, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn làm chỗ ngự.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 사자들의 손으로 그들에게 [말씀을] 보내셨으니, 일찍 일어나 보내셨다. 그분께서 그분의 백성과 그분의 거처를 불쌍히 여기셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 사자들을 통해 그들에게 거듭거듭 말씀을 보내셨다. 그분께서 그분의 백성과 그분이 계시는 곳을 불쌍히 여기셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 사자들을 보내셔서 그들에게 경고하셨다. 그분께서는 사자들을 몇 번이고 보내셨다. 그분께서 자기 백성과 그분이 계시려고 정하신 곳을 불쌍히 여기셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais, enviou [avisos] a eles pela mão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mensageiros, madrugando e enviando, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha compaixão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} habitação.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, lhes enviou avisos por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mensageiros, uma vez após outra, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha compaixão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e do lugar da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} habitação.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, mandou mensageiros para avisá-los. Mandou-os muitas e muitas vezes, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha pena do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e do lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha feito a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} casa.

decisions.choice: rising early and sending: again and again, with urgency
decisions.reason: To rise early to do something is to do it eagerly and without delay. The phrase is used in Jeremiah of Yahweh sending his prophets time after time (Jeremiah 7:25; 25:4; 29:19).

decisions.choice: he had compassion: the warnings came from Yahweh's mercy
decisions.reason: The verb means to have pity and so to spare. Yahweh's messengers were sent because he did not want to destroy his people. The same verb returns in verse 17, where the king of the Chaldeans has no pity.

decisions.choice: his dwelling: the temple in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The word means a dwelling or home. Here it is the house where Yahweh had put his name (7:16), as in Psalm 26:8.

decisions.choice: his messengers: the prophets
decisions.reason: The word for messenger can also mean an angel, but here it means the prophets, as verse 16 shows.

decisions.choice: again and again (Balanced); over and over (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: to warn them; the place he had made his home
decisions.reason: Readable says what the messengers were sent for, and explains "his dwelling" (m3).

decisions.choice: "madrugando y enviando" (L); "una y otra vez" (B); "muchas veces" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[des avertissements]" at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sent" has no object; French "envoya" needs one, so Literal brackets it where the English needs none.

decisions.choice: akiamka mapema na kutuma
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of rising early to send; Balanced and Readable say what it means, "tena na tena" (again and again).

decisions.choice: "dậy sớm mà sai đi" (L); "cứ liên tục" (B); "hết lần này đến lần khác" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of rising early (m1); the other levels give its sense.

decisions.choice: "일찍 일어나 보내셨다" at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of rising early to send, which means doing so again and again (m1).

decisions.choice: madrugando e enviando (L); uma vez após outra (B); muitas e muitas vezes (R); compaixão (L, B), pena (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of rising early to send (m1), and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. The verb of pity (m2) is "ter compaixão" at Literal and Balanced, and verse 17 keeps it for the king who had none.

source.text: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ מַלְעִבִים֙ בְּמַלְאֲכֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּבוֹזִ֣ים דְּבָרָ֔יו וּמִֽתַּעְתְּעִ֖ים בִּנְבִאָ֑יו עַ֠ד עֲל֧וֹת חֲמַת־יְהוָ֛ה בְּעַמּ֖וֹ עַד־לְאֵ֥ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And they were mocking at [the] messengers of the God, and despising his words, and scoffing at his prophets, until went up [the] wrath of Yahweh against his people, until to there [was] no healing.

en.L: But they kept mocking the messengers of God and despising {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words and scoffing at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} prophets, until the wrath of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rose against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, until there was no remedy.
en.B: But they made fun of God's messengers, scorned {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words and sneered at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} prophets, until the fury of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rose up against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and nothing could heal them.
en.R: But the people made fun of God's messengers. They treated {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words as worthless and laughed at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} prophets. At last {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger rose up against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, and nothing could heal them anymore.

es.L: Pero ellos se burlaban de los mensajeros de Dios, y menospreciaban {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras, y se mofaban de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} profetas, hasta que subió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, hasta que no hubo remedio.
es.B: Pero ellos se burlaron de los mensajeros de Dios, despreciaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras y se mofaron de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} profetas, hasta que el furor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se levantó contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y ya nada pudo sanarlos.
es.R: Pero el pueblo se burlaba de los mensajeros de Dios. Trataban {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras como si no valieran nada y se reían de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} profetas. Por fin la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se levantó contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, y ya nada podía sanarlos.

fr.L: Mais ils se moquaient des messagers de Dieu, et méprisaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles, et raillaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prophètes, jusqu’à ce que la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} monte contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait plus de remède.
fr.B: Mais ils se moquèrent des messagers de Dieu, méprisèrent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles et tournèrent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prophètes en ridicule, jusqu’à ce que la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} monte contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et que rien ne puisse plus le guérir.
fr.R: Mais les gens se sont moqués des messagers de Dieu. Ils ont traité {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles comme si elles ne valaient rien et ils ont ri de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prophètes. À la fin, la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est levée contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et plus rien ne pouvait le guérir.

sw.L: Lakini walikuwa wakiwadhihaki wajumbe wa Mungu, na kuyadharau maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na kuwacheka manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, mpaka ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikapanda juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, hata pasiwe na dawa.
sw.B: Lakini waliwadhihaki wajumbe wa Mungu, wakayadharau maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuwacheka manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, mpaka ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikapanda juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wala hapakuwa na kitu cha kuwaponya.
sw.R: Lakini watu waliwadhihaki wajumbe wa Mungu. Waliyaona maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuwa hayana maana, wakawacheka manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Mwishowe hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikapanda juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wala hapakuwa tena na kitu cha kuwaponya.

vi.L: Nhưng họ cứ chế nhạo các sứ giả của Đức Chúa Trời, khinh dể lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cười nhạo các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cho đến khi cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lên nghịch cùng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cho đến khi không còn phương cứu chữa.
vi.B: Nhưng họ chế giễu các sứ giả của Đức Chúa Trời, khinh bỉ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nhạo báng các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cho đến khi cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lên nghịch cùng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không còn gì chữa lành được nữa.
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng chế giễu các sứ giả của Đức Chúa Trời. Họ coi lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng ra gì và cười nhạo các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Cuối cùng cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lên nghịch cùng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không còn gì chữa lành họ được nữa.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 하나님의 사자들을 조롱하고 그분의 말씀들을 업신여기고 그분의 예언자들을 비웃어서, 마침내 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 그분의 백성에게 치솟아, 고칠 길이 없게 되었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 하나님의 사자들을 조롱하고, 그분의 말씀을 멸시하고, 그분의 예언자들을 비웃었다. 마침내 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 그분의 백성에게 치솟아, 더 이상 고칠 길이 없었다.
ko.R: 그러나 백성은 하나님의 사자들을 놀려 댔다. 그들은 그분의 말씀을 하찮게 여기고 그분의 예언자들을 비웃었다. 마침내 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 크게 노하셨고, 이제는 아무것도 그들을 고칠 수 없었다.

pt.L: Mas eles zombavam dos mensageiros de Deus, e desprezavam as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} palavras, e escarneciam dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} profetas, até que o furor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} subiu contra o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, até que não houve remédio.
pt.B: Mas eles zombavam dos mensageiros de Deus, desprezavam as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} palavras e escarneciam dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} profetas, até que o furor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se levantou contra o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e nada mais podia curá-los.
pt.R: Mas o povo zombava dos mensageiros de Deus. Eles tratavam as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} palavras como se não valessem nada e riam dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} profetas. Por fim, a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se levantou contra o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, e nada mais podia curá-lo.

decisions.choice: they were mocking ... despising ... scoffing: a lasting habit
decisions.reason: The verb "were" with three participles describes what the people kept doing over time, answering Yahweh's repeated sending in verse 15.

decisions.choice: the wrath of Yahweh went up: his anger rose to its full height
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as rising like heat or smoke (Psalm 78:21, 31). Yahweh's patience had held it back; now it came.

decisions.choice: until there was no healing: the damage was past repair
decisions.reason: Healing stands for restoring a people from the harm their sin has brought (7:14; 30:20). Now there was no longer any way to turn back the judgment.

decisions.choice: remedy (Literal); nothing could heal them (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The noun means healing or a cure. Literal says "remedy"; Balanced and Readable keep the picture of healing in a clause.

decisions.choice: zombavam dos mensageiros de Deus (every level); desprezavam, escarneciam
decisions.reason: The three verbs of a lasting habit (m1) are in the imperfect, "zombavam", "desprezavam", "escarneciam", which says what the people kept doing; "zombavam dos mensageiros de Deus" is kept at every level, so that the charge reads the same at each.

decisions.choice: não houve remédio (L); nada mais podia curá-los (B), curá-lo (R)
decisions.reason: The noun means healing (m3): Literal says "remédio", as the English says "remedy", and Balanced and Readable keep the picture of healing in a clause, the word of 7:14's "curarei a sua terra".

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַל עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג בַּחוּרֵיהֶ֤ם בַּחֶ֨רֶב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית מִקְדָּשָׁ֔ם וְלֹ֥א חָמַ֛ל עַל־בָּח֥וּר וּבְתוּלָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְיָשֵׁ֑שׁ הַכֹּ֖ל נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought up against them [the] king of [the] Chaldeans, and he killed their young men with the sword in [the] house of their sanctuary, and not he had compassion on young man and young woman, old and aged; the all he gave into his hand.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, and he killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and he had no compassion on young man or young woman, old man or aged; all [of them] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave into his hand.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought the king of the Chaldeans against them, and the king put their young men to the sword in their own sanctuary. He had no compassion on young man or young woman, on the old or the frail. God gave them all into his hand.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought the king of the Babylonians against them. He killed their young men with the sword, even inside the temple. He did not spare anyone, young men or young women, old people or those weak with age. God handed them all over to him.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo subir contra ellos al rey de los caldeos, que mató a espada a sus jóvenes en la casa de su santuario, y no tuvo compasión del joven ni de la doncella, ni del anciano ni del decrépito; a todos [los] entregó {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en su mano.
es.B: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} trajo contra ellos al rey de los caldeos, que pasó a espada a sus jóvenes en su propio santuario. No tuvo compasión ni del joven ni de la muchacha, ni del anciano ni del débil. Dios los entregó a todos en su mano.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} trajo contra ellos al rey de los babilonios. Él mató a espada a sus jóvenes, aun dentro del templo. No perdonó a nadie, ni a los jóvenes ni a las muchachas, ni a los ancianos ni a los que estaban débiles por la edad. Dios se los entregó a todos.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fit monter contre eux le roi des Chaldéens, et celui-ci tua leurs jeunes gens par l’épée dans la maison de leur sanctuaire, et il n’eut pitié ni du jeune homme ni de la jeune fille, ni du vieillard ni de l’homme âgé ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} livra tout entre ses mains.
fr.B: Ainsi, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fit venir contre eux le roi des Chaldéens, qui fit périr par l’épée leurs jeunes gens dans leur propre sanctuaire. Il n’épargna ni jeune homme ni jeune fille, ni vieillard ni homme affaibli par l’âge. Dieu les livra tous entre ses mains.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait venir contre eux le roi des Babyloniens. Celui-ci a tué leurs jeunes gens par l’épée, même à l’intérieur du temple. Il n’a épargné personne, ni les jeunes hommes ni les jeunes filles, ni les vieillards ni ceux qui étaient affaiblis par l’âge. Dieu les a tous livrés entre ses mains.

sw.L: Naye akapandisha juu yao mfalme wa Wakaldayo, naye akawaua vijana wao kwa upanga katika nyumba ya patakatifu pao, wala hakumhurumia kijana wala msichana, mzee wala mkongwe; wote akawatia mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo alimleta mfalme wa Wakaldayo dhidi yao, naye mfalme akawaua vijana wao kwa upanga ndani ya patakatifu pao. Hakumhurumia kijana wala msichana, mzee wala aliyedhoofika. Mungu aliwatia wote mkononi mwake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimleta mfalme wa Wababeli dhidi yao. Aliwaua vijana wao kwa upanga, hata ndani ya hekalu. Hakumhurumia mtu yeyote, vijana wa kiume wala wa kike, wazee wala walio dhaifu kwa uzee. Mungu aliwatia wote mikononi mwake.

vi.L: Ngài đem vua của người Canh-đê lên đánh họ, và vua ấy dùng gươm giết các thanh niên của họ trong nhà thánh của họ; vua ấy không thương xót thanh niên hay thiếu nữ, người già hay người tuổi cao sức yếu; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phó tất cả vào tay vua ấy.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem vua của người Canh-đê đến đánh họ, và vua ấy dùng gươm giết các thanh niên của họ ngay trong nơi thánh của họ. Vua ấy không thương xót thanh niên hay thiếu nữ, người già hay người yếu đuối. Đức Chúa Trời phó tất cả vào tay vua ấy.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem vua Ba-by-lôn đến đánh họ. Vua ấy dùng gươm giết các thanh niên của họ, ngay cả trong đền thờ. Vua ấy không tha một ai, dù là thanh niên hay thiếu nữ, người già hay người yếu vì tuổi tác. Đức Chúa Trời đã phó tất cả vào tay vua ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 주께서 갈대아 사람들의 왕을 그들에게로 올라오게 하셨다. 그리고 그가 그들의 성소의 집에서 그들의 젊은이들을 칼로 죽였고, 젊은 남자나 젊은 여자나 노인이나 늙은이를 불쌍히 여기지 않았다. 주께서 그 모두를 그의 손에 넘기셨다.
ko.B: 그래서 주께서는 갈대아 사람들의 왕을 그들에게 쳐들어오게 하셨다. 그 왕은 그들의 성소 안에서 젊은이들을 칼로 죽였다. 그는 젊은 남자도 젊은 여자도, 노인도 늙어 쇠약한 사람도 불쌍히 여기지 않았다. 하나님께서 그들을 모두 그의 손에 넘기셨다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 바빌로니아 사람들의 왕이 그들을 치게 하셨다. 그 왕은 성전 안에서까지 그들의 젊은이들을 칼로 죽였다. 그는 젊은 남자든 젊은 여자든, 노인이든 늙어 약한 사람이든 아무도 살려 두지 않았다. 하나님께서 그들을 모두 그 왕에게 넘겨주셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez subir contra eles o rei dos caldeus, que matou os seus jovens à espada na casa do seu santuário, e não teve compaixão de jovem nem de moça, de velho nem de idoso; a todos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregou na mão dele.
pt.B: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trouxe contra eles o rei dos caldeus, e o rei matou à espada os seus jovens no seu próprio santuário. Ele não teve compaixão de rapaz nem de moça, nem dos velhos nem dos fracos. Deus entregou todos nas mãos dele.
pt.R: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe contra eles o rei dos babilônios. O rei matou os jovens deles à espada, até dentro do templo. Não poupou ninguém, nem rapazes nem moças, nem velhos nem os que estavam fracos pela idade. Deus entregou todos nas mãos dele.

decisions.choice: he brought up ... he gave: Yahweh; he killed, he had no compassion: the king of the Chaldeans
decisions.reason: The first and last verbs have Yahweh as their subject, carrying on from verses 15-16. The verbs between have the king of the Chaldeans as subject. The sentence frames the slaughter with Yahweh's judgment.

decisions.choice: had no compassion: the pity that had been refused
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 15 of Yahweh's compassion on his people and his dwelling. The people scorned that compassion; now they faced a king who showed none.

decisions.choice: the Chaldeans: the people whose kings ruled Babylon
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 24:2 and 25:4: the Chaldeans were a people of southern Mesopotamia, and Nebuchadnezzar's family came from them.

decisions.choice: the house of their sanctuary: the temple
decisions.reason: The temple, the holy place where they worshiped, gave no refuge. Lamentations 2:20-21 mourns priest and prophet killed in the sanctuary, and young and old lying in the streets.

decisions.choice: God gave them all (Balanced); God handed them all over (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the subject of "gave" (m1), since "he" would seem to mean the king. Readable also names Yahweh at the start and says "Babylonians" for the Chaldeans, as at 2 Kings 25:10.

decisions.choice: "los caldeos" (L, B); "los babilonios" (R); "Dios los entregó" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "babilonios" for the Chaldeans, as Spanish 2 Kings 25 does; Balanced and Readable name God as the one who gave them up, since "él" would seem to mean the king (m1).

decisions.choice: "les Chaldéens" (Literal, Balanced); "les Babyloniens" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 25.

decisions.choice: Wakaldayo (L, B); Wababeli (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili of 2 Kings 24-25, Readable names the Chaldeans as the people of Babylon.

decisions.choice: "người Canh-đê" (L, B); "Ba-by-lôn" (R)
decisions.reason: As the 2 Kings 25 drafts; Readable names the kingdom, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "갈대아 사람들" (Literal, Balanced), "바빌로니아 사람들" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set in the 2 Kings 13-25 drafts; "주께서" stands for the pronoun "he" at Literal and is not a divine_name span.

decisions.choice: o rei dos caldeus (L, B), o rei dos babilônios (R); não teve compaixão (L, B); Deus entregou (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Os caldeus" at Literal and Balanced and "os babilônios" at Readable, as 2 Kings 25:4 sets them (m3). "Compaixão" repeats the verb of verse 15 (m2). Balanced and Readable name God as the one who gave them up, and the king as the one who killed (m1), as the English does.

source.text: וְ֠כֹל כְּלֵ֞י בֵּ֤ית הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הַגְּדֹלִ֣ים וְהַקְּטַנִּ֔ים וְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֹצְר֥וֹת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֑יו הַכֹּ֖ל הֵבִ֥יא בָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] vessels of [the] house of the God, the great and the small, and [the] treasures of [the] house of Yahweh and [the] treasures of the king and his princes, the all he brought [to] Babylon.

en.L: And all the vessels of the house of God, the great and the small, and the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all [of it] he brought [to] Babylon.
en.B: He carried to Babylon all the vessels of the house of God, large and small, the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the treasures belonging to the king and his officials.
en.R: He took to Babylon all the objects from God's temple, large and small. He also took the treasures of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and the treasures of the king and his leaders.

es.L: Y todos los utensilios de la casa de Dios, grandes y pequeños, y los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y los tesoros del rey y de sus príncipes, todo [lo] llevó [a] Babilonia.
es.B: Llevó a Babilonia todos los utensilios de la casa de Dios, grandes y pequeños, los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los tesoros del rey y de sus jefes.
es.R: Se llevó a Babilonia todos los objetos del templo de Dios, grandes y pequeños. También se llevó los tesoros del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los tesoros del rey y de sus dirigentes.

fr.L: Et tous les objets de la maison de Dieu, les grands et les petits, et les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et les trésors du roi et de ses princes, il emporta tout [à] Babylone.
fr.B: Il emporta à Babylone tous les objets de la maison de Dieu, grands et petits, les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les trésors du roi et de ses chefs.
fr.R: Il a emporté à Babylone tous les objets du temple de Dieu, les grands comme les petits. Il a aussi pris les trésors du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les trésors du roi et de ses chefs.

sw.L: Na vyombo vyote vya nyumba ya Mungu, vikubwa na vidogo, na hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na hazina za mfalme na za wakuu wake, vyote akavileta [mpaka] Babeli.
sw.B: Alipeleka Babeli vyombo vyote vya nyumba ya Mungu, vikubwa na vidogo, hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na hazina za mfalme na za maafisa wake.
sw.R: Alipeleka Babeli vitu vyote vya hekalu la Mungu, vikubwa na vidogo. Alichukua pia hazina za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na hazina za mfalme na za viongozi wake.

vi.L: Mọi vật dụng của nhà Đức Chúa Trời, lớn và nhỏ, các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các kho báu của vua và của các thủ lĩnh của vua, vua ấy đem tất cả về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vua ấy đem về Ba-by-lôn mọi vật dụng của nhà Đức Chúa Trời, lớn và nhỏ, các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và các kho báu của vua cùng các quan chức của vua.
vi.R: Vua ấy đem về Ba-by-lôn mọi đồ vật trong đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời, lớn và nhỏ. Vua ấy cũng lấy các báu vật của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các báu vật của vua và các người lãnh đạo.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 집의 크고 작은 모든 기구와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 보물과 왕과 그의 지도자들의 보물, 그 모든 것을 그가 바빌론으로 가져갔다.
ko.B: 그는 하나님의 집의 크고 작은 모든 기구와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 보물과 왕과 관리들의 보물을 모두 바빌론으로 가져갔다.
ko.R: 그는 하나님의 성전에 있던 크고 작은 물건들을 모두 바빌론으로 가져갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전의 보물과 왕과 지도자들의 보물도 가져갔다.

pt.L: E todos os utensílios da casa de Deus, os grandes e os pequenos, e os tesouros da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e os tesouros do rei e dos seus príncipes, tudo [isso] ele levou [para a] Babilônia.
pt.B: Ele levou para a Babilônia todos os utensílios da casa de Deus, grandes e pequenos, os tesouros da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os tesouros do rei e dos seus oficiais.
pt.R: Ele levou para a Babilônia todos os objetos do templo de Deus, grandes e pequenos. Também levou os tesouros do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os tesouros do rei e dos seus líderes.

decisions.choice: all the vessels, great and small: the last of the temple's treasures
decisions.reason: Some vessels had gone under Jehoiakim (verse 7) and the precious ones with Jehoiachin (verse 10); now everything went. 2 Kings 25:13-17 lists the bronze pillars, stands and Sea that were broken up and carried off. Chronicles sums it all up, and Ezra 1:7-11 counts the vessels Cyrus gave back.

decisions.choice: he brought: the king of the Chaldeans
decisions.reason: The subject carries on from verse 17. The Hebrew lists the goods first and ends with "all of it he brought to Babylon", so that the whole list falls under that one verb.

decisions.choice: princes / officials / leaders
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the king's princes in these books.

decisions.choice: tudo [isso] ele levou (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the list first and the one verb at the end (m2); Balanced and Readable put the verb first, as the English does. The officials are "príncipes" (L), "oficiais" (B) and "líderes" (R), as the book has them.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׂרְפוּ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַֽיְנַתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְכָל־אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וְכָל־כְּלֵ֥י מַחֲמַדֶּ֖יהָ לְהַשְׁחִֽית׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they burned [the] house of the God and broke down [the] wall of Jerusalem, and all its palaces they burned with the fire, and all [the] vessels of its preciousness [were] for destroying.

en.L: And they burned the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and all its palaces they burned with fire, and all its precious vessels [they gave] to destruction.
en.B: They burned the house of God and tore down the wall of Jerusalem. They burned all its palaces with fire and destroyed all its precious things.
en.R: The Babylonians burned God's temple and tore down Jerusalem's wall. They burned down all the palaces and destroyed everything valuable in the city.

es.L: Y quemaron la casa de Dios, y derribaron el muro de Jerusalén, y todos sus palacios los quemaron a fuego, y todos sus objetos preciosos [fueron] para destrucción.
es.B: Incendiaron la casa de Dios y derribaron el muro de Jerusalén. Quemaron a fuego todos sus palacios y destruyeron todos sus objetos de valor.
es.R: Los babilonios quemaron el templo de Dios y derribaron la muralla de Jerusalén. Incendiaron todos los palacios y destruyeron todo lo valioso que había en la ciudad.

fr.L: Et ils brûlèrent la maison de Dieu et démolirent la muraille de Jérusalem, et tous ses palais, ils les brûlèrent par le feu, et tous ses objets précieux, [ils les livrèrent] à la destruction.
fr.B: Ils incendièrent la maison de Dieu et démolirent la muraille de Jérusalem. Ils brûlèrent tous ses palais et détruisirent tous ses objets précieux.
fr.R: Les Babyloniens ont brûlé le temple de Dieu et ont démoli la muraille de Jérusalem. Ils ont mis le feu à tous les palais et ils ont détruit tout ce qui avait de la valeur dans la ville.

sw.L: Wakaiteketeza nyumba ya Mungu, wakaubomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu, na majumba yake yote ya kifalme wakayateketeza kwa moto, na vyombo vyake vyote vya thamani [wakavitoa] viharibiwe.
sw.B: Waliiteketeza nyumba ya Mungu na kuubomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu. Waliyateketeza kwa moto majumba yake yote ya kifalme, wakaviharibu vitu vyake vyote vya thamani.
sw.R: Wababeli walilichoma moto hekalu la Mungu, wakaubomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu. Waliyachoma majumba yote ya kifalme, wakaharibu kila kitu cha thamani katika mji.

vi.L: Họ đốt nhà Đức Chúa Trời, phá đổ tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, đốt bằng lửa mọi cung điện trong thành, và [phó] mọi vật dụng quý giá của thành cho sự hủy diệt.
vi.B: Họ đốt nhà Đức Chúa Trời và phá đổ tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ phóng hỏa đốt mọi cung điện trong thành và phá hủy mọi đồ vật quý giá.
vi.R: Quân Ba-by-lôn đốt đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời và phá đổ tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem. Chúng đốt cháy mọi cung điện và phá hủy mọi thứ có giá trị trong thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 집을 불사르고, 예루살렘 성벽을 허물고, 그 모든 궁궐을 불로 사르고, 그 모든 귀한 기구를 [멸망에 넘겼다].
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 집을 불사르고 예루살렘 성벽을 허물었다. 그들은 그 성의 모든 궁궐을 불태우고 귀한 물건들을 모두 부수어 버렸다.
ko.R: 바빌로니아 사람들은 하나님의 성전을 불태우고 예루살렘 성벽을 허물었다. 그들은 성안의 궁궐들을 모두 불태우고, 값진 것은 모두 부수어 버렸다.

pt.L: E queimaram a casa de Deus, e derrubaram o muro de Jerusalém, e todos os seus palácios queimaram com fogo, e todos os seus objetos preciosos [entregaram] à destruição.
pt.B: Eles queimaram a casa de Deus e derrubaram o muro de Jerusalém. Queimaram todos os seus palácios e destruíram todos os seus objetos de valor.
pt.R: Os babilônios queimaram o templo de Deus e derrubaram o muro de Jerusalém. Queimaram todos os palácios e destruíram tudo o que havia de valor na cidade.

decisions.choice: a short form of 2 Kings 25:9-10
decisions.reason: Kings says Nebuzaradan burned the house of Yahweh, the king's palace and every great house, and that the army broke down the walls around Jerusalem. Chronicles names the house of God first and says "they", the Chaldeans, without naming the commander.

decisions.choice: palaces: strong, high buildings
decisions.reason: The word names the tall, fortified houses of a city's rulers and wealthy (Amos 3:10-11; Psalm 48:4).

decisions.choice: all its precious vessels for destroying: everything of value was ruined
decisions.reason: The phrase has no main verb: "to destroy" sums up what became of everything precious in the city. "Its" is Jerusalem, or the city's great houses.

decisions.choice: [they gave] to destruction (Literal); the Babylonians (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies a verb in brackets for the verbless phrase (m3). Readable names the Babylonians as "they", and says "everything valuable in the city" for "its precious vessels".

decisions.choice: [entregaram] à destruição (L); Os babilônios (R)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies a verb in brackets for the phrase that has none (m3), as the English does; Readable names who "they" were.

source.text: וַיֶּ֛גֶל הַשְּׁאֵרִ֥ית מִן־הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־בָּבֶ֑ל וַֽיִּהְיוּ־ל֤וֹ וּלְבָנָיו֙ לַעֲבָדִ֔ים עַד־מְלֹ֖ךְ מַלְכ֥וּת פָּרָֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And he exiled the remnant from the sword to Babylon, and they became to him and to his sons as slaves until [the] reigning of [the] kingdom of Persia,

en.L: And he carried into exile to Babylon the remnant [that escaped] from the sword, and they became slaves to him and to his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,
en.B: He carried into exile to Babylon those who had escaped the sword, and they became servants to him and to his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power,
en.R: The king of Babylon took the people who had not been killed away to Babylon as captives. They served him and his sons until the Persian kingdom took power.

es.L: Y llevó cautivos a Babilonia a los que escaparon de la espada, y fueron esclavos de él y de sus hijos hasta que reinó el reino de Persia,
es.B: Llevó cautivos a Babilonia a los que habían escapado de la espada, y fueron siervos de él y de sus hijos hasta que llegó al poder el reino de Persia,
es.R: El rey de Babilonia se llevó cautivos a Babilonia a los que no habían muerto. Ellos le sirvieron a él y a sus hijos hasta que el reino de Persia llegó al poder.

fr.L: Et il déporta à Babylone le reste [qui avait échappé] à l’épée, et ils lui furent esclaves, à lui et à ses fils, jusqu’au règne du royaume de Perse,
fr.B: Il déporta à Babylone ceux qui avaient échappé à l’épée, et ils furent ses serviteurs et ceux de ses fils jusqu’à l’avènement du royaume de Perse,
fr.R: Le roi de Babylone a emmené à Babylone comme prisonniers les gens qui n’avaient pas été tués. Ils l’ont servi, lui et ses fils, jusqu’à ce que le royaume de Perse prenne le pouvoir.

sw.L: Naye akawahamisha mpaka Babeli mabaki [walioponyoka] upanga, nao wakawa watumwa kwake na kwa wanawe mpaka utawala wa ufalme wa Uajemi,
sw.B: Aliwachukua uhamishoni mpaka Babeli wale walioponyoka upanga, nao wakawa watumishi wake na wa wanawe mpaka ufalme wa Uajemi ulipoanza kutawala,
sw.R: Mfalme wa Babeli aliwachukua mateka mpaka Babeli watu ambao hawakuuawa. Walimtumikia yeye na wanawe mpaka ufalme wa Uajemi ulipochukua mamlaka.

vi.L: Vua ấy bắt những người sống sót khỏi gươm đem lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn, và họ làm nô lệ cho vua ấy và các con trai vua ấy cho đến khi vương quốc Ba Tư cai trị,
vi.B: Vua ấy bắt những người thoát khỏi gươm đem lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn, và họ phải làm tôi tớ cho vua ấy và các con trai vua ấy cho đến khi vương quốc Ba Tư lên nắm quyền,
vi.R: Vua Ba-by-lôn bắt những người không bị giết đem sang Ba-by-lôn làm tù binh. Họ phải phục dịch vua ấy và các con trai vua ấy cho đến khi vương quốc Ba Tư lên nắm quyền.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 칼에서 [피한] 남은 자들을 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔고, 그들은 페르시아 왕국이 다스릴 때까지 그와 그의 아들들의 종이 되었다.
ko.B: 그는 칼을 피해 살아남은 사람들을 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔다. 그들은 페르시아 왕국이 일어설 때까지 그와 그의 아들들의 종이 되었다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 죽임을 당하지 않고 살아남은 사람들을 포로로 바빌론에 끌고 갔다. 그들은 페르시아 왕국이 일어설 때까지 그와 그의 아들들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E levou para o exílio, para a Babilônia, o restante [que escapou] da espada, e eles se tornaram escravos dele e dos seus filhos até o reinado do reino da Pérsia,
pt.B: Ele levou para o exílio, na Babilônia, os que tinham escapado da espada, e eles se tornaram servos dele e dos seus filhos até que o reino da Pérsia chegou ao poder,
pt.R: O rei da Babilônia levou como prisioneiros para a Babilônia as pessoas que não tinham sido mortas. Elas serviram a ele e aos seus filhos até que o reino da Pérsia tomou o poder.

decisions.choice: the remnant from the sword: those who survived the killing
decisions.reason: The remnant are those left alive after the slaughter of verse 17. 2 Kings 25:11 lists them: the rest of the people in the city, those who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the population.

decisions.choice: slaves: subjects forced to serve a conquering king
decisions.reason: The word names people bound to serve a master. The exiles were not free: they lived under Babylon's rule and served its kings, as Jeremiah said the nations would serve Nebuchadnezzar, his son and his grandson (Jeremiah 27:7).

decisions.choice: until the kingdom of Persia reigned: until 539 BC
decisions.reason: Cyrus king of Persia took Babylon in 539 BC, and Babylon's rule ended. The following verses tell what came of it.

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced); served (Readable)
decisions.reason: The usual wording for this word: "slave" at Literal, "servant" at Balanced and Readable (m2).

decisions.choice: The king of Babylon
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject of "he exiled" and ends the sentence here; verse 21 begins a new sentence at Readable only.

decisions.choice: "esclavos" (L); "siervos" (B); "le sirvieron" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets *ʿeved*: "esclavo" at Literal, "siervo" at Balanced (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: kuhamisha (L); kuchukua uhamishoni (B); kuchukua mateka (R)
decisions.reason: Exile is worded as in the Swahili of 2 Kings 13-25.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "tôi tớ" (B); "phục dịch" (R)
decisions.reason: Forced service to a conquering king (m2), not God's servants, for whom "đầy tớ" is kept; the three levels follow the English slaves / servants / served.

decisions.choice: "종" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Korean "종" covers both "slave" and "servant", as in the Samuel and Kings drafts; the sentence runs on into verse 21 at Literal and Balanced, so the verse ends with "되었다" and verse 21 begins with "이는".

decisions.choice: levou para o exílio (L, B), levou como prisioneiros (R); escravos (L), servos (B), serviram (R)
decisions.reason: The exile keeps the words 2 Kings 24:14 and 25:11 give it at each level; the word for slaves (m2) is "escravos" at Literal and "servos" at Balanced, as the Old Testament terms set it. "A Pérsia" takes its usual Portuguese form (m3).

source.text: לְמַלֹּ֤אות דְּבַר־יְהוָה֙ בְּפִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ עַד־רָצְתָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתֶ֑יהָ כָּל־יְמֵ֤י הָשַּׁמָּה֙ שָׁבָ֔תָה לְמַלֹּ֖אות שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: to fulfill [the] word of Yahweh by [the] mouth of Jeremiah, until had enjoyed the land its sabbaths; all [the] days of its desolation it kept sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

en.L: to fulfill the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths; all the days of its desolation it kept sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
en.B: to fulfill the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoken by Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. All the days that it lay desolate it kept Sabbath, until seventy years were complete.
en.R: This made the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} come true, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken through Jeremiah. The land lay empty, and at last it had its Sabbath years. It rested all the time it lay empty, until seventy years were over.

es.L: para que se cumpliera la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por boca de Jeremías, hasta que la tierra hubo gozado de sus sábados; todos los días de su desolación reposó, hasta que se cumplieron setenta años.
es.B: para que se cumpliera la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} anunciada por Jeremías, hasta que la tierra hubo disfrutado de sus sábados. Todo el tiempo que estuvo desolada guardó el sábado, hasta que se cumplieron setenta años.
es.R: Así se cumplió la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho por medio de Jeremías. La tierra quedó vacía, y por fin tuvo sus años de descanso. Descansó todo el tiempo que estuvo vacía, hasta que pasaron setenta años.

fr.L: pour accomplir la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [prononcée] par la bouche de Jérémie, jusqu’à ce que le pays ait joui de ses sabbats ; tous les jours de sa désolation, il observa le sabbat, jusqu’à l’accomplissement de soixante-dix ans.
fr.B: pour accomplir la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} prononcée par Jérémie, jusqu’à ce que le pays ait joui de ses sabbats. Pendant tout le temps où il resta dévasté, il observa le sabbat, jusqu’à ce que soixante-dix ans soient accomplis.
fr.R: Ainsi s’est réalisée la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, celle qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par Jérémie. Le pays est resté vide, et il a enfin eu ses années de sabbat. Il s’est reposé pendant tout le temps où il est resté vide, jusqu’à la fin des soixante-dix ans.

sw.L: ili kulitimiza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kinywa cha Yeremia, mpaka nchi ilipofurahia Sabato zake; siku zote za kuwa ukiwa kwake ilishika Sabato, ili kutimiza miaka sabini.
sw.B: ili kutimiza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lililosemwa na Yeremia, mpaka nchi ilipofurahia Sabato zake. Siku zote ilipokuwa ukiwa ilishika Sabato, mpaka miaka sabini ilipotimia.
sw.R: Hivi neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolisema kupitia Yeremia likatimia. Nchi ilikaa tupu, na mwishowe ikapata miaka yake ya Sabato. Ilipumzika muda wote ilipokuwa tupu, mpaka miaka sabini ilipokwisha.

vi.L: để làm trọn lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [phán] qua miệng Giê-rê-mi, cho đến khi đất được hưởng các năm Sa-bát của nó; suốt những ngày hoang vu, đất giữ Sa-bát, cho đến khi trọn bảy mươi năm.
vi.B: để làm trọn lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Giê-rê-mi, cho đến khi đất được hưởng các năm Sa-bát của nó. Suốt những ngày bị bỏ hoang, đất được nghỉ Sa-bát, cho đến khi trọn bảy mươi năm.
vi.R: Như vậy lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Giê-rê-mi được ứng nghiệm. Đất bị bỏ trống, và cuối cùng đất được hưởng những năm Sa-bát của nó. Đất được nghỉ ngơi suốt thời gian bị bỏ trống, cho đến khi trọn bảy mươi năm.

ko.L: 이는 예레미야의 입으로 [하신] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 이루시려는 것이었으니, 땅이 그 안식년들을 누리기까지 [그렇게 되었다]. 땅은 황폐한 모든 날 동안 안식하여, 70년을 채웠다.
ko.B: 이것은 예레미야를 통해 하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었다. 그리하여 땅은 마침내 안식년들을 누렸다. 땅은 황폐하게 버려져 있는 동안 내내 안식하여 70년을 채웠다.
ko.R: 이렇게 하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야를 통해 하신 말씀이 이루어졌다. 땅은 텅 빈 채로 버려져 있었고, 마침내 안식년을 누리게 되었다. 땅은 버려져 있는 동안 내내 쉬었고, 70년이 다 찼다.

pt.L: para cumprir a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pela boca de Jeremias, até que a terra tivesse desfrutado os seus sábados; todos os dias da sua desolação ela guardou o sábado, para completar setenta anos.
pt.B: para que se cumprisse a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} anunciada por Jeremias, até que a terra tivesse desfrutado os seus sábados. Durante todo o tempo em que ficou desolada, ela descansou, até se completarem setenta anos.
pt.R: Assim se cumpriu a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha falado por meio de Jeremias. A terra ficou vazia e, finalmente, teve os seus anos sabáticos. Ela descansou durante todo o tempo em que ficou vazia, até que se completaram setenta anos.

decisions.choice: the word of Yahweh by Jeremiah: seventy years
decisions.reason: Jeremiah said that the nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years (Jeremiah 25:11-12), and that after seventy years for Babylon Yahweh would bring his people back (Jeremiah 29:10). Daniel 9:2 also reads these words.

decisions.choice: until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths: the words of Leviticus 26:34-35
decisions.reason: Leviticus 26:34-35 warns that if Israel broke the covenant, the land would enjoy its sabbaths all the days of its desolation while the people were in their enemies' land, and would rest as it had not rested in their sabbaths (also 26:43). Chronicles uses those very words and joins them to Jeremiah's seventy years: the exile is the curse of Leviticus coming true.

decisions.choice: enjoyed: had its due, or paid off its debt
decisions.reason: The verb means to be pleased with or to accept, and in Leviticus 26:34, 41, 43 it may also mean to make up for or pay off. The land at last received the rest owed to it in the years when the people had not let it lie fallow.

decisions.choice: its sabbaths: the sabbath years of the land
decisions.reason: Every seventh year the land was to rest, with no sowing or harvest (Leviticus 25:1-7). The verse implies that these years had long been neglected.

decisions.choice: to fulfill seventy years: until the full seventy years were complete
decisions.reason: The seventy years are counted as the full time the land lay desolate and the people served Babylon (verse 20), a span set by Yahweh's word. Chronicles does not give its starting and ending points.

decisions.choice: the wording of Leviticus 26:34-35
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording from Leviticus 26:34-35 where the Hebrew is the same: "enjoyed its sabbaths", "all the days of its desolation" (Literal); "enjoyed its Sabbaths", "lay desolate" (Balanced); "at last it had its Sabbath years", "lay empty" (Readable). Balanced capitalizes Sabbath as Leviticus does at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: This made the word of the LORD come true
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence here and states the purpose as a result, since verse 20 ended its sentence.

decisions.choice: "sus sábados" (L, B); "sus años de descanso" (R)
decisions.reason: The sabbath years of the land (m4): "sábado" at Literal and Balanced as the Pentateuch note sets it, and Readable explains them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "jouir de ses sabbats" (Literal, Balanced); "ses années de sabbat" (Readable); "sabbat" in lowercase
decisions.reason: The words of Leviticus 26:34-35 (m2), as French writes the sabbath in lowercase, though the English capitalizes it at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "70년" in figures; "안식년들을 누리다" for the land enjoying its sabbaths
decisions.reason: Years are in figures in this block; the land's sabbaths are its sabbath years (Leviticus 25:4; 26:34-35), so Korean says "안식년".

decisions.choice: até que a terra tivesse desfrutado os seus sábados (L, B); todos os dias da sua desolação (L), durante todo o tempo em que ficou desolada (B); os seus anos sabáticos, ficou vazia (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Leviticus 26:34-35 return here (m2), and Portuguese keeps that passage's wording at each level: "desfrutar os seus sábados" and "todos os dias da sua desolação" (L), "durante todo o tempo em que ficar desolada" and "descansará" (B), "os seus anos sabáticos" and "ficar vazia" (R). "Sábados" is lowercase, as the style sets it, where the English Balanced writes "Sabbaths".

decisions.choice: pela boca de Jeremias (L), anunciada por Jeremias (B), por meio de Jeremias (R); setenta anos
decisions.reason: The "setenta anos" are those Jeremiah announced (Jeremiah 25:11-12; 29:10), linked to his name in the same sentence (m1, m5), so that verse 22 can take up "a palavra do SENHOR ... de Jeremias" in the same words at each level. The round number is written in words.

source.text: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־יְהוָ֖ה בְּפִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ר֨וּחַ֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־קוֹל֙ בְּכָל־מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And in year one of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill [the] word of Yahweh by [the] mouth of Jeremiah, stirred up Yahweh [the] spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he caused to pass a voice in all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,

en.L: And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by the mouth of Jeremiah, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he sent a proclamation through all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,
en.B: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, so that the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoken by Jeremiah would be fulfilled, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he had a proclamation announced throughout his kingdom and also put it in writing:
en.R: In the first year that Cyrus king of Persia ruled, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the word {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken through Jeremiah come true. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} moved Cyrus king of Persia to act. Cyrus sent out a message to be announced all through his kingdom, and he also had it written down. It said:

es.L: Y en el primer año de Ciro rey de Persia, para que se cumpliera la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por boca de Jeremías, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despertó el espíritu de Ciro rey de Persia, el cual hizo pregonar por todo su reino, y también por escrito, diciendo:
es.B: En el primer año de Ciro rey de Persia, para que se cumpliera la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} anunciada por Jeremías, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despertó el espíritu de Ciro rey de Persia, y él mandó pregonar por todo su reino, y también lo puso por escrito:
es.R: En el primer año del reinado de Ciro, rey de Persia, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cumplió la palabra que había dicho por medio de Jeremías. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} movió a Ciro, rey de Persia, a actuar. Ciro mandó anunciar un mensaje por todo su reino, y también lo hizo poner por escrito. Decía así:

fr.L: Et la première année de Cyrus, roi de Perse, pour accomplir la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [prononcée] par la bouche de Jérémie, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Cyrus, roi de Perse, et celui-ci fit passer une proclamation dans tout son royaume, et aussi par écrit, en disant :
fr.B: La première année de Cyrus, roi de Perse, afin que s’accomplisse la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} prononcée par Jérémie, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Cyrus, roi de Perse, et celui-ci fit publier dans tout son royaume, et aussi par écrit, cette proclamation :
fr.R: La première année du règne de Cyrus, roi de Perse, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a réalisé la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par Jérémie. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a poussé Cyrus, roi de Perse, à agir. Cyrus a fait annoncer un message dans tout son royaume, et il l’a aussi fait mettre par écrit. Ce message disait :

sw.L: Na katika mwaka wa kwanza wa Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi, ili kulitimiza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kinywa cha Yeremia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaiamsha roho ya Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi, naye akapitisha tangazo katika ufalme wake wote, na pia kwa maandishi, akisema,
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kwanza wa Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi, ili neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lililosemwa na Yeremia litimie, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliiamsha roho ya Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi, naye akaagiza tangazo litangazwe katika ufalme wake wote na kuandikwa pia:
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wa Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilifanya neno alilolisema kupitia Yeremia litimie. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimgusa Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi moyoni ili atende. Koreshi akatuma ujumbe utangazwe katika ufalme wake wote, akaagiza uandikwe pia. Ulisema:

vi.L: Năm thứ nhất đời Si-ru vua Ba Tư, để làm trọn lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [phán] qua miệng Giê-rê-mi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giục lòng Si-ru vua Ba Tư, và vua ấy truyền rao khắp vương quốc mình, và cũng [ban] bằng văn bản, rằng:
vi.B: Năm thứ nhất đời Si-ru vua Ba Tư, để lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Giê-rê-mi được ứng nghiệm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giục lòng Si-ru vua Ba Tư ban hành một chiếu chỉ khắp vương quốc và cũng viết thành văn bản:
vi.R: Năm thứ nhất Si-ru vua Ba Tư cai trị, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua Giê-rê-mi được ứng nghiệm. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giục lòng Si-ru vua Ba Tư hành động. Si-ru gửi đi một thông báo để loan báo khắp vương quốc của mình, và cũng cho viết ra. Thông báo ấy như sau:

ko.L: 그리고 페르시아 왕 고레스 제1년에, 예레미야의 입으로 [하신] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 이루시려고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 페르시아 왕 고레스의 마음을 감동시키셨다. 그래서 그가 그의 온 나라에 공포하고 또 글로도 써서 말했다.
ko.B: 페르시아 왕 고레스가 다스린 첫해에, 예레미야를 통해 하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 이루시려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 페르시아 왕 고레스의 마음을 움직이셨다. 그래서 고레스는 온 나라에 명령을 내려 알리고, 또 그것을 글로 써서 이렇게 선포했다.
ko.R: 페르시아 왕 고레스가 다스린 첫해에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 예레미야를 통해 하신 말씀을 이루셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 페르시아 왕 고레스의 마음을 움직여 일을 하게 하셨다. 고레스는 자기 나라 곳곳에 소식을 알리게 하고, 그것을 글로도 적게 했다. 그 내용은 이러했다.

pt.L: E no primeiro ano de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, para cumprir a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pela boca de Jeremias, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, e ele fez passar uma proclamação por todo o seu reino, e também por escrito, dizendo:
pt.B: No primeiro ano de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, para que se cumprisse a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} anunciada por Jeremias, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, e ele mandou anunciar uma proclamação por todo o seu reino e também a pôs por escrito:
pt.R: No primeiro ano em que Ciro, rei da Pérsia, governou, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} cumpriu a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha falado por meio de Jeremias. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levou Ciro, rei da Pérsia, a agir. Ciro mandou anunciar uma mensagem por todo o seu reino e também a mandou escrever. Ela dizia:

decisions.choice: the same words as Ezra 1:1
decisions.reason: Verses 22-23 are repeated, almost word for word, at the start of the book of Ezra (Ezra 1:1-3a). Ezra 1:1 says "from the mouth of Jeremiah" where Chronicles says "by the mouth", with no change in meaning. The history that Chronicles ends here, Ezra takes up and continues.

decisions.choice: the first year of Cyrus: his first year as ruler of Babylon, about 538 BC
decisions.reason: Cyrus had ruled Persia for years before he took Babylon in 539 BC. The first year meant here is the first year of his rule over Babylon and its lands, including Judah. Cyrus's own records tell that he let peoples taken by Babylon return and restore their temples.

decisions.choice: stirred up the spirit of Cyrus: moved him to act
decisions.reason: To stir up someone's spirit is to rouse their will (1 Chronicles 5:26; 2 Chronicles 21:16; Haggai 1:14). A foreign king's decision is told as Yahweh's work. Isaiah 44:28 and 45:1 name Cyrus as the one Yahweh would use to rebuild Jerusalem and the temple.

decisions.choice: caused a voice to pass: had a proclamation announced
decisions.reason: To make a voice pass through a land is to send heralds to announce something aloud (Exodus 36:6; Ezra 10:7). Cyrus also put it in writing.

decisions.choice: to fulfill the word of Yahweh by Jeremiah: the end of the seventy years
decisions.reason: As in verse 21, the word is Jeremiah's promise that after seventy years Yahweh would bring his people back (Jeremiah 29:10). The same word that fixed the length of the exile also fixed its end.

decisions.choice: made the word ... come true; moved Cyrus ... to act
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long sentence into short ones, says what stirring up the spirit means (m3), and states the fulfillment as what Yahweh did.

decisions.choice: saying, (Literal); a colon (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into the proclamation in verse 23. Literal ends with "saying," and Balanced with a colon; Readable adds "It said:".

decisions.choice: "Ciro rey de Persia"; "despertó el espíritu" (L, B); "movió ... a actuar" (R)
decisions.reason: Cyrus in his usual Spanish form; Readable says what stirring up the spirit means (m3). These verses are the same Hebrew as Ezra 1:1-3, which can reuse this Spanish.

decisions.choice: "Cyrus, roi de Perse"
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the name of the Persian king.

decisions.choice: "Si-ru vua Ba Tư"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant form of the name; Ezra 1:1 has the same words and should reuse this wording.

decisions.choice: "마음을 감동시키셨다" for "stirred up the spirit"
decisions.reason: As at 21:16, Korean "영" would suggest the Spirit of God, so "마음" is used for the king's will that Yahweh moved.

decisions.choice: Ciro, rei da Pérsia; despertou o espírito (L, B), levou ... a agir (R); fez passar uma proclamação (L), mandou anunciar uma proclamação (B)
decisions.reason: Verses 22-23 are repeated at the start of Ezra (m1), so their wording is set here for Ezra 1:1-3 to repeat at each level: "Ciro, rei da Pérsia", the usual Brazilian form; "despertou o espírito" at Literal and Balanced for the idiom of stirring the will (m3), with Readable saying what it means; and "a palavra do SENHOR ... Jeremias" in the words of verse 21 (m5).

source.text: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ׀מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֗ס כָּל־מַמְלְכ֤וֹת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ נָ֣תַן לִ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהֽוּא־פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה מִֽי־בָכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־עַמּ֗וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהָ֛יו עִמּ֖וֹ וְיָֽעַל׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: all [the] kingdoms of the earth has given to me Yahweh [the] God of the heavens, and he has appointed me to build for him a house in Jerusalem which [is] in Judah. Who [is] among you of all his people? Yahweh his God [be] with him, and let him go up.

en.L: "Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of heaven, has given to me, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has appointed me to build {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a house in Jerusalem, which [is] in Judah. Whoever [is] among you of all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{gender:their|his}} God [be] with {{gender:them|him}}, and let {{gender:them|him}} go up."
en.B: "Cyrus king of Persia says this: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has appointed me to build a house for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever among you is one of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{gender:their|his}} God be with {{gender:them|him}}, and let {{gender:them|him}} go up."
en.R: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: All the kingdoms of the earth have been given to me by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of heaven. He has chosen me to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in Jerusalem, in Judah. All of you who belong to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God be with you. You are free to go up there."

es.L: «Así dice Ciro rey de Persia: Todos los reinos de la tierra me los ha dado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de los cielos, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha encargado que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} edifique una casa en Jerusalén, que [está] en Judá. Quien de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [sea] de todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios [sea] con él, y suba».
es.B: «Ciro rey de Persia dice esto: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de los cielos, me ha dado todos los reinos de la tierra, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha encargado que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} edifique una casa en Jerusalén, que está en Judá. Cualquiera de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que pertenezca a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios esté con él, y que suba».
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice Ciro, rey de Persia: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de los cielos, me ha dado todos los reinos de la tierra. Él me ha escogido para que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} construya un templo en Jerusalén, en Judá. Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los que {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios esté con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} ir allá».

fr.L: « Ainsi parle Cyrus, roi de Perse : Tous les royaumes de la terre, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu des cieux, me les a donnés, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a chargé de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison à Jérusalem, qui [est] en Juda. Quiconque [est] parmi vous de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu [soit] avec lui, et qu’il monte ! »
fr.B: « Cyrus, roi de Perse, dit ceci : {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu des cieux, m’a donné tous les royaumes de la terre, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a chargé de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison à Jérusalem, qui est en Juda. Quiconque parmi vous fait partie de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu soit avec lui, et qu’il monte ! »
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit Cyrus, roi de Perse : Tous les royaumes de la terre m’ont été donnés par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu du ciel. Il m’a choisi pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} construire un temple à Jérusalem, en Juda. Vous tous qui faites partie de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu soit avec vous. Vous êtes libres de monter là-bas. »

sw.L: "Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi asema hivi: Falme zote za dunia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mbinguni, amenipa, naye ameniagiza nimjengee nyumba huko Yerusalemu, ulioko Yuda. Yeyote [aliye] kati yenu wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake [na awe] pamoja naye, na apande."
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mbinguni, amenipa falme zote za dunia, naye ameniagiza nimjengee nyumba huko Yerusalemu, ulioko Yuda. Yeyote kati yenu aliye wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake na awe pamoja naye, naye apande."
sw.R: "Hili ndilo Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi analosema: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mbinguni, amenipa falme zote za dunia. Amenichagua nimjengee hekalu huko Yerusalemu, katika Yuda. Ninyi nyote mlio watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu na awe pamoja nanyi. Mko huru kwenda huko."

vi.L: "Si-ru vua Ba Tư nói thế này: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời trên trời, đã ban cho ta mọi vương quốc trên đất, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho ta xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một ngôi nhà tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, [thành] ở Giu-đa. Ai trong các ngươi thuộc về dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của người ấy, ở cùng người ấy, và hãy để người ấy đi lên."
vi.B: "Si-ru vua Ba Tư nói như vầy: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời trên trời, đã ban cho ta mọi vương quốc trên đất, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho ta xây một ngôi nhà cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, ở Giu-đa. Ai trong các ngươi thuộc về dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của người ấy, ở cùng người ấy, và người ấy hãy đi lên."
vi.R: "Đây là lời Si-ru vua Ba Tư: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời trên trời, đã ban cho ta mọi vương quốc trên đất. Ngài đã chọn ta để xây một đền thờ cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, ở Giu-đa. Hỡi tất cả những ai thuộc về dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, ở cùng các ngươi. Các ngươi được tự do đi lên đó."

ko.L: "페르시아 왕 고레스가 이와 같이 말한다. 하늘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅의 모든 나라를 나에게 주셨고, 그분께서 유다에 있는 예루살렘에 그분을 위하여 집을 지으라고 나에게 명하셨다. 너희 가운데 그분의 모든 백성에 속한 자는 누구든지, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그와 함께하시기를 [빈다]. 그는 올라가라."
ko.B: "페르시아 왕 고레스가 이렇게 말한다. 하늘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 세상의 모든 나라를 나에게 주시고, 유다에 있는 예루살렘에 그분의 성전을 지으라고 나에게 명하셨다. 너희 가운데 그분의 백성인 사람은 누구든지, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 함께하시기를 빈다. 그는 올라가거라."
ko.R: "페르시아 왕 고레스가 하는 말이다. 하늘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 세상의 모든 나라를 나에게 주셨다. 그분께서는 유다의 예루살렘에 그분의 성전을 지으라고 나를 택하셨다. 너희 가운데 그분의 백성은 모두, 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 함께하시기를 빈다. 너희는 그곳으로 올라가도 좋다."

pt.L: "Assim diz Ciro, rei da Pérsia: Todos os reinos da terra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos céus, me deu, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me encarregou de {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} edificar uma casa em Jerusalém, que [está] em Judá. Quem [há] entre vocês, de todo o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, [seja] com ele, e suba."
pt.B: "Assim diz Ciro, rei da Pérsia: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos céus, me deu todos os reinos da terra, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me encarregou de construir uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} em Jerusalém, que fica em Judá. Quem dentre vocês pertence ao povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, esteja com ele, e que suba."
pt.R: "É isto que Ciro, rei da Pérsia, diz: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos céus, me deu todos os reinos da terra. Ele me escolheu para construir um templo para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} em Jerusalém, em Judá. Todos vocês que pertencem ao povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, esteja com vocês. Vocês estão livres para subir até lá."

decisions.choice: Ezra 1:2-3a, and where Ezra goes on
decisions.reason: Ezra 1:2-3 has the same proclamation. Where Chronicles has "Yahweh his God be with him", Ezra has "may his God be with him", and Ezra goes on: "and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel".

decisions.choice: let him go up: the book ends with a call to return
decisions.reason: Chronicles ends in the middle of the decree, on the word "let him go up". After the burning of the temple and the exile, the last word is an open door: the people may go back and the house may be built again. The verb is the one used for going up to Jerusalem and its temple (Psalm 122:4). In most printed Hebrew Bibles Chronicles is the last book, so the whole Hebrew Bible ends on this word.

decisions.choice: the God of heaven: a title used in the Persian period
decisions.reason: Cyrus speaks of Yahweh by a title the Persian kings and their officials used for the God of the Jews (Ezra 5:11-12; 6:9-10; 7:12; Nehemiah 1:4). The words are a royal decree in the style of the time, which credited each people's god for the king's success.

decisions.choice: he has appointed me: he has charged me with a task
decisions.reason: The verb means to assign a duty or put someone in charge. The house is to be built for Yahweh, as the temple of Solomon was (2:3; 6:7-10).

decisions.choice: who among you ...: whoever among you; Yahweh his God with him: a wish
alternatives: Yahweh his God is with him
decisions.reason: "Who" here introduces anyone at all who belongs to Yahweh's people. The words "Yahweh his God with him" have no verb and are taken as a blessing, "may he be with him", as in Ezra 1:3. They could also be read as a statement, "Yahweh his God is with him".

decisions.choice: Thus says / says this / This is what ... says
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this formula when a king or prophet speaks. Each speech opens and closes its quotation within the verse.

decisions.choice: their / them (default), his / him (alternative)
decisions.reason: The decree speaks to anyone of Yahweh's people, men and women alike, so Literal and Balanced use the gender setting for "his" and "him".

decisions.choice: your God be with you; You are free to go up there
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the hearers directly, as "among you" does, and says what "let him go up" allows. "There" points back to Jerusalem; Readable, like the others, does not complete the sentence with the words Ezra 1:3 adds (m2).

decisions.choice: "con él", "suba", no gender setting; plural_you for "among you"
decisions.reason: Spanish "él" after "quien" is the generic for anyone, man or woman, so the English gender setting has no real Spanish counterpart; the decree speaks to many, so "you" is the plural setting, and Readable speaks to the hearers directly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "Quiconque ... avec lui, et qu'il monte"
decisions.reason: French "quiconque ... il" already speaks of anyone, man or woman, as the style guide sets, so French needs no span where the English has "their" / "his".

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle" (Literal); "dit ceci" (Balanced); "Voici ce que dit" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula of these books, for the Persian king as for the Assyrian (32:10).

decisions.choice: yeyote ... Mungu wake ... pamoja naye; no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "yeyote" and the third-person "wake", "naye" serve for men and women alike, so the English their/his span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "nói thế này" (L); "nói như vầy" (B); "Đây là lời ..." (R) for Cyrus
decisions.reason: Vietnamese keeps "phán" for God (and, in 32:10, for the Assyrian king's claim to divine authority); Cyrus honors the LORD and is given the plain verb. A reviewer may prefer "phán" for a royal edict.

decisions.choice: "người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: his"

decisions.choice: "그의", "그와", "그는" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "그" here refers back to "누구든지" and does not mark a man, so the setting has nothing to change; Readable speaks to "너희", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Cyrus's decree in 해라체, with the honorific for Yahweh ("주셨고", "명하셨다")
alternatives: no honorific, as for the Assyrians
decisions.reason: A royal decree to subject peoples uses the plain style; unlike Sennacherib, Cyrus speaks of Yahweh with honor as the God of heaven who gave him his kingdoms.

decisions.choice: Assim diz Ciro, rei da Pérsia (L, B), É isto que Ciro, rei da Pérsia, diz (R); o Deus dos céus; me encarregou (L, B), me escolheu (R)
decisions.reason: The decree's wording is set here for Ezra 1:2-3 to repeat (m1): the messenger formula as the book has it for a king's word, at each level; "o Deus dos céus" for the Persian title (m3), in the plural of the Hebrew, as "o exército dos céus" (33:3); "encarregar" for appointing to a task (m4). Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the kingdoms first.

decisions.choice: Quem ... com ele, e suba (no gender setting)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "quem" already means anyone, man or woman, and the "ele" and "suba" that refer back to it are ordinary generic Portuguese (style section 7), so Literal and Balanced need no gender setting where the English has one. The blessing is a wish (m5), "[seja]" (L) and "esteja" (B, R), and the book ends, as the Hebrew does, on the call to go up (m2): "suba" (L, B), "subir até lá" (R).
